released.title: Windows 11 main menu fix
released.summary: Windows 11 players whose mods bring their own models, materials or textures get past the main menu again.

features.title: No more main-menu crash on Windows 11 with content mods
features.text: On Windows 11 the game reads its files through a newer Windows reader that Kiln did not answer, so a mod's own models, materials and textures read as empty and the game stopped in the main menu ("error loading streamed texture mip tail" in its log). Kiln now has the game use its standard reader, the one it uses on Windows 10 and with its --disable-ioring launch option (thanks Rebur, KR-KZRX).

features.title: Support reports spot this crash
features.text: A support report from an older Kiln that hit this crash now says so and names the --disable-ioring launch option, which can be removed after updating.

released.title: Steady map icons
released.summary: Map icons that mods place with Kiln.Markers stay on the world map in every frame, at any frame rate, instead of blinking above 60 fps.

features.title: Mod markers on the world map no longer flicker
features.text: The game rebuilds its list of map markers in every frame, and Kiln added the mods' icons only at the game's 60 steps per second, so above 60 fps they blinked. Kiln now puts them back after every frame's rebuild; the game's own markers, Kiln's compass strip and its world labels were never affected (thanks cykel-far, #159).

released.title: ShroudForge 1.8 mods with grouped choices
released.summary: ShroudForge 1.8 mods whose settings sort their choices into groups, such as Gear Up, can be added again, and when Kiln does refuse a ShroudForge mod it names the setting and what ShroudForge expects.

features.title: Gear Up and other ShroudForge 1.8 mods can be added
features.text: Add mods refused Gear Up as "invalid metadata": the launcher and Kiln's in-game Mods page now take ShroudForge 1.8's grouped choices, and the Mods page shows each group as a heading over its choices (thanks Ezra).

features.title: ShroudForge refusals say what is wrong
features.text: When a ShroudForge mod breaks ShroudForge's own rules, Kiln names the setting and the field and says what ShroudForge expects, instead of "invalid metadata", and it refuses the same things ShroudForge refuses.

released.title: Greeneye mods beside other hooks
released.summary: Greeneye Loader mods such as Hollow Halls Progression read the same game code they found again where Kiln or another mod has hooked the game, and kiln.log says what a Greeneye mod asked for when it does not start.

features.title: Greeneye mods read the code they found
features.text: Hollow Halls Progression stopped at the start with "unsupported game signatures" next to Kiln's newer hooks: Greeneye mods now get the game's own code where Kiln or another mod has hooked it, the same code they found (thanks Dark-Thoughts).

features.title: Why a Greeneye mod did not start
features.text: When a Greeneye mod stops at the start, kiln.log names the game signatures it could not find and where Kiln read the game's code, so a support report shows what went wrong.

released.title: Cameras anywhere, Kiln's overlay by choice
released.summary: Mod cameras can go anywhere in the world, players with a frame generation mod can choose to draw Kiln's overlay anyway, the launcher shows up once in the app menu under Gear Lever, and Ultimate ASI Loader under two names no longer stops Install.

features.title: Mod cameras without a distance limit
features.text: A mod's camera no longer has to stay within 250 m of your character: a mod can show your whole base from 300 m up, or frame a huge mount from far behind.

features.title: Draw Kiln's overlay anyway
features.text: Next to an NVIDIA Streamline frame generation mod or OptiScaler, a switch in the launcher draws Kiln's overlay and HUD mods anyway, at your own risk (thanks Soligna).

features.title: Once in the app menu under Gear Lever
features.text: The launcher's AppImage no longer adds a second Kiln Launcher entry when Gear Lever or another AppImage tool already added one (thanks Dark-Thoughts).

features.title: Ultimate ASI Loader under two names
features.text: Install and Repair no longer refuse when another mod manager put Ultimate ASI Loader back over Kiln's loader: Kiln keeps the newer copy chained, and Play says so when it comes back (thanks KR-NXM5).

features.title: EML mods wait for a busy file
features.text: EML mods no longer all fail when the game you just quit is still closing: Kiln waits a moment for the file, and the launcher opens a Shroudtopia or ShroudForge mod's settings file (thanks sosmic).

released.title: ShroudForge mods in the right place
released.summary: A ShroudForge mod that Kiln also counted as an EML mod is one row under ShroudForge in the Kiln menu, with its switch and settings, and Chinese, Japanese or Korean text in mods shows instead of question marks.

features.title: One row per ShroudForge mod
features.text: Mods such as Mineral Production Boxes, Endless Chests and Quiver & Spellbook are listed once, under ShroudForge, and their switch and settings change the copy ShroudForge runs (thanks HTR).

features.title: Chinese, Japanese and Korean text in mods
features.text: Mod settings and names written in Chinese, Japanese or Korean show in an English (or any other) game: Kiln loads the game's own Chinese font the first time such text is drawn.

released.title: Spell picker without the flicker
released.summary: A mod's spell or arrow you pick in the HUD list no longer flickers back to the one before it for a moment, and testers can follow each pick in kiln.log.

features.title: No flicker after a pick
features.text: A spell or arrow a mod puts in the HUD list (Grimoire, for example) stays under the cursor after you pick it until the mod's swap arrives, instead of showing the previous spell for a moment and coming back, alone and on a dedicated server (thanks Fuzen777).

features.title: A pick trace for testers
features.text: With "ammoTrace": true in kiln.json's "ui" section, kiln.log follows each pick of a spell or arrow row frame by frame: the game's choice, each build of the list and what the HUD drew. It is off by default.

released.title: Settings past the slider and exact asset hashes
released.summary: A mod's setting can go past the end of its slider when the mod allows it, and a mod asset whose hash Kiln cannot read is now an error that names the file instead of content the game never finds.

features.title: Settings past the slider's end
features.text: A mod can make one end of a setting's range soft: the number field beside its slider, on the Kiln menu's config page and in the launcher, then takes a value past that end, and the config file keeps it instead of clamping it back (thanks fafawanji).

features.title: Mod assets with a hash Kiln cannot read
features.text: A mod asset whose hash is not written the way Kiln reads it is now an error in kiln.log that names the file, instead of loading under another hash the game never asks for, and one whose hash names another size than its file says so. kiln lint flags such a hash, and kiln-vfxcook writes the hash the way Kiln reads it.

released.title: Building tools, spell lists and ShroudForge in multiplayer
released.summary: Mods' building tools keep their own brushes and add terrain from the second start, a mod's spell or arrow list stays put while you scroll, and a ShroudForge mod that changes blocks tells you why it does nothing in a game you joined.

features.title: Building tools keep their brushes
features.text: Picking another brush size for a mod's building tool keeps the tool and its own brushes instead of turning it into the vanilla Overgrowth Tool, and each brush's preview shows the vanilla size nearest its own (thanks SonjaNemitz).

features.title: Building tools that add terrain
features.text: A building tool that adds terrain works from the second start of the game, also with the tool pool an earlier version kept (thanks SonjaNemitz).

features.title: Spell lists stay put while you scroll
features.text: A mod's spell or arrow list in place of the game's keeps its spells and arrows on screen while the game builds the list again: no flash of the game's own list after a switch, and on a dedicated server the cursor no longer jumps back to the equipped spell (thanks Fuzen777).

features.title: ShroudForge block edits in a joined game
features.text: A ShroudForge mod that changes the world's blocks in a game you joined now says why it does nothing there: one message over the game and a kiln.log line naming the mod. Only the server or the player hosting can change blocks, so run such a mod there (thanks netjunk).

released.title: The festive season
released.summary: From the Monday after Thanksgiving through 7 January the launcher's fire is dressed for the winter holidays, and a server's web panel can always open on this computer.

features.title: Warm wishes for the season
features.text: From the Monday after Thanksgiving weekend through 7 January, the launcher's fire wears a festive mantel of lamps, candles and lanterns from many winter traditions, with snow falling outside the arch. You can switch it off in Settings.

features.title: Always open the web panel on this computer
features.text: A switch on a server's Overview keeps Open web panel on this computer, never at the panel's hosted address.

features.title: The route panel on a map without map art
features.text: On a server's Map with no map art, the route panel sits below the notice, so it can be closed again.

released.title: Thanksgiving turkey, smoother registry, ShroudForge news
released.summary: A turkey roasts over the launcher's fire over Thanksgiving weekend, big registry packs hitch less after the world loads, ShroudForge mods' messages show in game, and the server Map page and Open web panel get fixes.

features.title: Happy Thanksgiving
features.text: Over Thanksgiving weekend, a turkey roasts over the launcher's fire.

features.title: Less hitching from big registry packs
features.text: After the world loads, Kiln writes registry.json on a thread of its own instead of the game's tick, and a start with registry content no longer fills kiln.log with tens of thousands of lines.

features.title: ShroudForge mod news in game
features.text: What a ShroudForge mod tells you now pops up over the game as a Kiln message and stays in that mod's details on Kiln's ShroudForge page.

features.title: The server Map page fits the window
features.text: The server Map page fills the window at every size, including the Steam Deck's, and dialogs and menus opened over the map take clicks again.

features.title: Open web panel at your panel's own address
features.text: With Kilnwarden 0.1.4 and hosted access on, Open web panel opens the panel at its own address after a quick check, or on this computer when the check fails.

released.title: Respec from linked chests, ShroudForge block writes
released.summary: Skill respecs pay Runes from linked chests, ShroudForge mods can change the world's blocks under Kiln again, ShroudForge shortcuts are set by pressing them, and the launcher and registry get several fixes.

features.title: Respec with Runes from linked chests
features.text: Unlearning a skill node and the Flame Altar's skill reset take their Runes from your linked chests too, after your bag and your base's Magic chests, all or nothing.

features.title: ShroudForge mods change blocks again
features.text: ShroudForge mods such as Altar Cleanup can change the world's blocks under Kiln again, with their undo, and a mod with one failed change no longer shows as not loaded.

features.title: Set ShroudForge shortcuts by pressing them
features.text: Set a ShroudForge mod's shortcut by pressing the key you want; typing in Kiln's menu no longer triggers ShroudForge mod shortcuts, and key names follow your keyboard layout.

features.title: Update notices clear after an update
features.text: A mod's update notice clears as soon as you install the update yourself, without restarting the launcher.

features.title: Hosting your own world reports nothing missing
features.text: Hosting your own world no longer reports your own mods as missing, and on other servers the missing list also checks ShroudForge, Flame, Green Eye and SET mods.

features.title: Leaving a server's page
features.text: Play now leaves a server's World and Players tabs, and unsaved changes on a server's page ask before you leave.

features.title: Clearer support reports
features.text: Support reports say when kiln-eml handed your EML packs to Kiln's ShroudForge, and no longer say Kiln did not load when the game ended while Kiln was starting.

features.title: Conflicts names EML mods per field
features.text: The Conflicts page names the EML mod on the field it changed, and changes made after the world loaded show up within seconds.

features.title: Safer mod reloads
features.text: A reload that changes a mod's side is refused until a restart, a reloaded mod's data packs keep their place, and old registry plans are cleaned up at each successful start.

released.title: Registry edits take effect, roll back and keep saves safe
released.summary: Mods' loot, drop, item and balance changes through Kiln's registries take effect on this game build, can be rolled back, never damage saves, and joining checks you made the server's balance changes.

features.title: Registry edits take effect
features.text: Mods that change loot rarities, drop tables, shield block, instrument comfort or stamina cost through Kiln's registries now change the game.

features.title: Mods can remove items
features.text: A removed item leaves loot, recipes and drop tables; the copies you already own stay.

features.title: Roll back registry changes
features.text: kilnctl and the launcher's Conflicts view can start the next boot on the last registry plan a world started on cleanly, with a dry run first; saves are never touched.

features.title: Registry edits keep saves safe
features.text: A lower stack limit keeps bigger stacks whole, and an edit that would narrow item levels or build zones against a world is refused with a reason.

features.title: Joining checks registry balance
features.text: Joining a server checks that your game made the same balance changes, such as level cap or XP, and says to use the server's modpack if not.

features.title: Item and recipe changes reach joined players
features.text: Item and recipe changes a server makes while you're connected reach you without rejoining.

features.title: Reloads say what waits for a restart
features.text: Reloading a mod, kilnctl status and the launcher name the registry edits that wait for a restart, and a data pack that fails while it reloads is undone completely.

features.title: Other loaders' writers named
features.text: The Conflicts page names ShroudForge and EML packages that changed an entry before Kiln, and flags values changed outside Kiln as best effort.

features.title: Conflicts view in every language
features.text: The launcher's Conflicts view is translated into all launcher languages.

features.title: When joined players see registry edits
features.text: Each registry field says when a joined Kiln player sees a server's edit, and a new lint suggests what players a data-only registry pack needs.

released.title: NPC speech, docked windows, linked-chest building
released.summary: Mods can make NPCs speak and dock their windows together; building and station fills use linked chests; removed mods leave nothing behind in your game data.

features.title: NPCs say what mods want
features.text: Mods can show their own lines in villagers' and craftspeople's speech bubbles, or quiet them.

features.title: Docked mod windows
features.text: Mod windows that dock to each other move together in the same frame.

features.title: Building from linked chests
features.text: The hammer lists and pays blocks from linked chests, also with Building Tools.

features.title: Station +1 / +n from links
features.text: A station's ingredient buttons count and take from linked chests.

features.title: Typing in Kiln's search fixed
features.text: Keys another mod sends no longer end up in Kiln's text fields.

features.title: No leftovers of removed mods
features.text: Kiln checks its clean copy of the game data against Steam's files, so an uninstalled mod's changes no longer stay in your game.

released.title: Lock prompts count linked chests
released.summary: A lock's "Required" line turns green when a linked chest holds the item.

features.title: Lock prompts count linked chests
features.text: A lock's "Required: Lockpick" line turns green when a linked chest has the pick, on a hosted world and on a Kiln server.

released.title: Kilnwarden's web panel and a font-cache fix
released.summary: Open web panel works with Kilnwarden, and the Linux launcher gets a way out of a broken font cache.

features.title: Open web panel works with Kilnwarden
features.text: The launcher's Open web panel shows for servers running Kilnwarden.

features.title: A way out of a broken font cache
features.text: On Linux, a launcher window stuck black in a broken font cache offers to fix it and restart.

released.title: FSR 4 on RX 6000, Beastmaster on Kiln, XHL's APIs
released.summary: FSR 4 on more AMD cards, Building Tools next to Kiln, Beastmaster without EMF, and four new APIs from XHL's requests.

features.title: FSR 4 on RX 6000 and RX 7000
features.text: FSR 4 no longer draws a black screen on RX 6000/7000 cards, and Kiln falls back to FSR 3.1 if its picture comes out wrong.

features.title: Building Tools next to Kiln
features.text: Kiln's cursor hook no longer hides the game code Building Tools looks for.

features.title: Beastmaster on Kiln alone
features.text: Beastmaster runs without EMF: orders, markers, buffs and its creature packs on Kiln's own EML runner.

features.title: XHL's APIs
features.text: Crosshair hits, game texts in every language, owned key presses and joined-client views (mod API 0.2.22).

released.title: Crafting from linked chests, everywhere
released.summary: Crafting menus, station fills, building and locks can use chests a mod links in other bases.

features.title: Crafting from linked chests works in every menu
features.text: Crafting stations, NPCs and the inventory craft from chests a mod links in other bases, without Cross-Base Storage (#132).

features.title: Linked chests for fills, building and locks
features.text: Mods can let linked chests feed station fills, the Construction Hammer and locks such as lockpicks (mod API 0.2.21, #147).

features.title: Markers on dedicated servers
features.text: Map markers reach joined Kiln players on dedicated servers.

features.title: Update game banner
features.text: Play shows a clear Update game banner when the game's Kiln is older than the launcher's.

released.title: Mods place their windows
released.summary: Mods can open their screens and windows where they belong and remember where you moved them.

features.title: Mod windows open where they belong
features.text: Mods can place their screens and windows and remember where you left them, always inside the screen (#146).

features.title: Screen and window placement
features.text: Position, MoveTo / Resize, Placement and RememberPlacement for Kiln screens and windows (mod API 0.2.20).

released.title: Fast spell switches keep the Spell slot
released.summary: A fast spell or arrow switch right after a mod's swap no longer empties the slot.

features.title: Fast spell switches keep the Spell slot
features.text: A pick of the spell a mod just swapped out of the backpack goes to the mod instead of emptying the slot (#145).

released.title: Inventory marks stay out of the game's menus
released.summary: Mod marks on inventory slots no longer cover the game's item menu, drop-downs or context menus.

features.title: Inventory marks stay out of the game's menus
features.text: A slot under the game's item menu, a drop-down or a context menu shows no mod mark while it is open (#117).

features.title: GameScreen.PopupOpen
features.text: Mods can tell when one of the game's popups covers its UI (mod API 0.2.19).

released.title: Packs install again after a mod changed its folder
released.summary: A pack install puts back a Library mod that changed its own files and keeps the player's copy aside.

features.title: Packs install again when a mod changed its own Library folder
features.text: Reinstalling a pack no longer fails when one of its mods wrote logs or settings into its Library folder; Kiln keeps the changed copy in kiln-changed.

released.title: Download missing mods for a pack
released.summary: An installed Crucible pack that is missing mods says so and downloads only what is missing.

features.title: Download missing mods for a pack
features.text: An installed pack missing a mod from your Library says so before you load it and downloads only what is missing.

released.title: Quieter saves on slow PCs
released.summary: A slow Kiln save writer is logged as a delay, not an error at every autosave.

features.title: No more save errors from a slow writer
features.text: When Kiln writes mod data more slowly than the game saves, kiln.log shows one warning and a summary instead of an error at every autosave.

released.title: Links that open the launcher, repair kits for mods
released.summary: Crucible and Nexus links work again when they start the launcher, and mods can use repair kits and pay item costs.

features.title: Crucible and Nexus links open the launcher again
features.text: A Crucible or Nexus link opened while the launcher is closed starts it and shows the preview or takes the download.

features.title: One window per link
features.text: A link opened while the launcher runs goes to that window once.

features.title: Repair kits and scrolls through mods
features.text: Mods that use items can use repair kits, and scrolls and mana grenades cost mana as from the hotbar.

released.title: Crucible codes without a profile
released.summary: Got a code and an empty local profile when no profile is loaded, and new profiles never take over another folder’s profile.

features.title: Got a code works without a profile
features.text: The Crucible "Got a code" link is on Play even when no local profile is loaded.

features.title: Create an empty local profile
features.text: Settings offers an empty local profile when nothing is loaded, without changing the game.

features.title: A new profile never takes over another folder's profile
features.text: A new profile gets its own ID instead of one a game still uses for another data folder's profile.

released.title: Korean review, EMF Lua host and kiln new fix
released.summary: A native-speaker review of the Korean translation, EMF Lua mods without a separate Lua mod, and kiln new installing its templates again.

features.title: Korean translation reviewed
features.text: kraewon7422 corrected 71 Korean texts in the launcher and the game.

features.title: EMF Lua mods work without EMF's Lua mod
features.text: Kiln ships EMF's unmodified Lua host and uses it only when an enabled EMF Lua script needs it (thanks matenm and the EMF contributors).

features.title: kiln new templates
features.text: kiln new installs its templates again on .NET SDKs with the newer "no templates found" message.

released.title: Creative effect toggles, sharing without a login
released.summary: Switch each creative effect on and off, share packs by link without Discord, save packs to a file on the Deck, and open Kiln Web Admin from the launcher.

features.title: Creative effect toggles
features.text: Each creative effect (invulnerability, no consume, unlimited flight and the rest) has its own switch in the F7 menu, /creative effect and the API, with the reason when one is locked.

features.title: Share without a login
features.text: Crucible makes unlisted links and codes without a Discord login, on desktop and Steam Deck; public publishing still needs sign-in.

features.title: Deck: save a pack as a file
features.text: When QR sign-in fails in Game Mode, the share screen saves the pack as a local .kilnpack.

features.title: Open Kiln Web Admin
features.text: Servers > Overview opens the Web Admin mod's panel, over SSH for remote servers.

features.title: EMF 0.6.22
features.text: Kiln accepts EMF's v49 SDK and headers next to v48.

released.title: No false "Will not run", crafting diagnostics
released.summary: Mods that need a recent Kiln load again, and clearer kiln.log lines for crafting from linked storage.

features.title: Crafting diagnostics
features.text: kiln.log says why the crafting menu left a recipe to the game, and where another mod changed a game function Kiln hooks (thanks Fuzen777).

features.title: No false "Will not run"
features.text: The launcher and kilnctl check mods against the release's own version, so a mod that needs Kiln 0.2.0-dev.28 or newer (several XHL ports) loads again.

released.title: Registries, values, UI, network and NPCs
released.summary: Kiln's own registries, so mods outlast game updates, and one data stage for all mods; mods' own character values and richer UI, map markers, station tabs, cloth on models and a debugger for the game client; control over what the server sends each player, survivors and bases, and friendly NPCs with bodies and routines of their own.

features.title: Kiln registries: mods that outlast game updates
features.text: Mods and data packs edit items, recipes, loot, drops and balance by Kiln's stable names. Kiln translates fields for the running game build and refuses unproven edits. Mods can add items and recipes and hide recipes or loot without deleting their records.

features.title: One data stage and a Conflicts view
features.text: Kiln applies startup registry edits in load order and reports competing changes in the launcher's Conflicts view. Mods choose when supported runtime edits run; the report says which edits won and which were refused.

features.title: Mods' own character values
features.text: Mods can give characters their own counters, currencies and experience with levels, saved with the character.

features.title: Richer UI windows
features.text: UI windows can have text fields, tables, tabs, trees and images, show live game values, and run commands on the server.

features.title: Map markers and labels
features.text: Mods can put markers on the game's map, on a compass strip and as labels in the world; servers can send them to players.

features.title: Station menu tabs
features.text: A mod's crafting station can have its own menu tabs, headings and recipe layout.

features.title: Cloth and chains on models
features.text: Modded models can have cloth and bone chains that the game itself simulates.

features.title: Debugger in the game client
features.text: Mod authors can attach a debugger to mods running in the game client and on a Windows dedicated server.

features.title: Network inspector
features.text: Mod authors and admins can see what the server sends each player: counters per player and channel, and watches on single entities.

features.title: Mod data on the network
features.text: Mods can send small data of their own with entities to Kiln players, and players without Kiln see safe stand-ins for Kiln-only items.

features.title: Survivor recruiting
features.text: Mods can recruit survivors, give their summon tool, move them into a base and assign their beds.

features.title: Larger bases
features.text: Mods can raise the number of Flame Altars a base may have and the build-zone size per altar level.

features.title: NPC bodies of your own
features.text: A friendly roster NPC can have a model and animations of the mod's own and still be a real villager.

features.title: Villager routines
features.text: Mods can give villagers a daily plan, such as roaming, sitting and sleeping, that stays after a restart.

features.title: Camera control
features.text: Mods can play camera paths for cutscenes, set a follow camera, field of view and shake, and lock a player's camera mode for a time.

features.title: Inventory owners, over-menu draws, and slider steps
features.text: Mods can query the kinds of inventory owners, list a base's containers, draw world overlays over menus by request, and set the steps used by config sliders.

features.title: Item icons
features.text: Item icon buttons keep their layout when scrolled out of view, and players can configure icon-cache limits.

features.title: Clearer player-storage and crafting diagnostics
features.text: Kiln reports which stage failed when a modded bag could not be set up and how far linked-stock payment got for a player craft.

features.title: Require a specific dev build
features.text: Mods that require a named Kiln dev build refuse earlier builds instead of running on an older runtime.

released.title: Fewer fake Flame Altars, server restarts and staged updates
released.summary: Kiln's terrain saves stop adding fake Flame Altars and base areas; servers restart and take mod and Kiln updates on their own; the launcher's Check now says what it found; the Nexus runtime comes as a folder.

features.title: Fewer fake Flame Altars
features.text: Kiln's terrain saves no longer add fake base areas, and add far fewer altars to the world list; big bases keep Kiln's edits (thanks bisdat).

features.title: Server restart and staged updates
features.text: Kiln.Admin restarts the server with a countdown and a save; mod and Kiln updates are applied at the next start, crash-safe, with one rollback.

features.title: Check now says what it found
features.text: About, Settings and the Deck say whether Kiln is up to date, what is available, or why the check failed (thanks HadToRegister).

features.title: Ready for Kiln Web Admin
features.text: Kiln.Admin's metrics, one-time logins and command forms, and the admin pages as a package for web pages.

released.title: Player storage on, building tools change terrain, EMF 0.6.20
released.summary: Player storage starts again on servers and hosted worlds; building tools from Kiln mods change terrain in a real game; EMF 0.6.20 mods load; crafting menus count linked containers.

features.title: Player storage starts again
features.text: 30.7 switched player storage off at start on servers and hosted worlds; it works now, and Kiln says which check failed if it can't (thanks Fuzen777).

features.title: Building tools change terrain
features.text: Strokes of Kiln mods' building tools reach the game's terraform, and Remove on the primary button works (thanks bisdat).

features.title: EMF 0.6.20
features.text: Mods built with EMF 0.6.20 (API v48) load on Kiln.

features.title: Crafting counts
features.text: Crafting menus count linked containers in their ingredient rows; station screens show what their buttons can move (thanks Fuzen777).

released.title: Player storage, Unlimited Flight, brushes in the picker
released.summary: Mod API 0.2.16 adds player storage (bags, quivers and spellbooks saved with the character, safe from loss and duplication); Kiln's own /unlimitedflight; Kiln tasks are no longer experimental; mods' building tools show their brushes; fixes for a blank NVIDIA launcher on Linux, big ShroudForge mods and the Steam Deck's report save.

features.title: Player storage for mods
features.text: Mods can give players bags, quivers and spellbooks of their own, saved with the character, shown in the HUD's ammo lists, kept when a mod or Kiln is removed, and protected against loss and duplication (thanks Fuzen777).

features.title: Unlimited Flight, built in
features.text: /unlimitedflight gives the host or an admin unlimited glider stamina and S/W steering without Creative Mode, within the server's limits.

features.title: Kiln tasks are normal API
features.text: Task-thread world reads and writes are no longer experimental: no opt-in needed.

features.title: Mods' brushes in the brush picker
features.text: Building tools from Kiln mods list their brushes in the game's picker at their sizes, and tool-only blocks files load (thanks bisdat).

features.title: Fixes for Linux, ShroudForge and the Deck
features.text: A blank NVIDIA launcher recovers by itself, ShroudForge mods that walk huge game assets start, a stale ShroudForge backup is never restored over current files, and reports save on the Steam Deck.

released.title: EMF blocks, block operations and crafting sources
released.summary: EMF mods built with the current EMF SDK load again and can read and break blocks; mod API 0.2.15 adds block operations and Fuzen777's crafting sources (craft and dye from linked chests); the save editor shows names in your game's language; Simplified Chinese covers 30.5.

features.title: EMF 0.6.19 and its block functions
features.text: Mods built with the current EMF SDK (Night Raids 1.3.0, Beastmaster 1.19.0, EMF Lua 1.40) load again, and EMF's block functions (what is at a cell, finding a wall, queued block breaking with ruin protection) work on Kiln.

features.title: Mod API 0.2.15: block operations
features.text: Kiln mods can read a block (kind, material, provenance, hardness, health), find the first wall between two points and break the blocks in a box with the game's own damage; natural ground and unbreakable blocks are never removed.

features.title: Fuzen777's requests: crafting sources, equipment, HUD lists
features.text: Mods can let players craft and dye from linked chests in any base or none, give items straight into an equipment slot, and add rows to the HUD's arrow and spell lists (thanks Fuzen777).

features.title: Save editor in your game's language
features.text: Item, skill and knowledge names come from the installed game's own translations in all 15 languages, and search finds both the translated and the English name.

features.title: Simplified Chinese
features.text: The launcher and in-game texts new in 30.5, translated by MagicFox (XHL).

features.title: Safer hosted worlds with mod content
features.text: Two rare hosted-world races in mod content are fixed: late model references written by the wrong side, and drop tables read while Kiln was still patching them.

released.title: Servers and Settings redesigned, building-tool APIs
released.summary: The Servers pages are redesigned and every server action shows its progress; Settings has sections and a search; mod API 0.2.14 adds custom building tools and Fuzen777's UI requests; the save editor adds dyes, undo and redo and a polish pass; launcher updates take one click; kiln mode's first start is much faster.

features.title: Servers, redesigned
features.text: One page per server with seven sections (Overview, Console, Players, World, Mods, Backups, Settings), a server switcher, and an Overview that shows the start stage by stage.

features.title: Server actions show progress
features.text: Start, Stop, Restart, Update the game and Install/Update Kiln show each step as it runs, say why one failed, and offer Try again.

features.title: Settings, redesigned
features.text: Six sections with short groups instead of one long page, and a search that jumps to any option.

features.title: Mod API 0.2.14: building tools and UI requests
features.text: Custom building tools that run the game's own terraform with Kiln's limits (filtered removal, paid placement from backpack and magic chests, the material picker, building-area checks, the game's own undo), legacy block identities, recipe menu groups and knowledge entries; controller keys for mod UIs, slot rarity and level, the game's item detail, and outlines through walls (thanks Fuzen777).

features.title: Save editor: dyes, undo and redo, safer saves
features.text: Dyes can be added, upgrade levels stay valid, undo and redo, restores that can't leave a half-written save, backups kept with their save, full keyboard use and layouts for small windows and the Deck.

features.title: One-click launcher updates
features.text: The launcher restarts by itself after an update (not while you play or have unsaved work), and the new Kiln goes into the game when it closes.

features.title: Faster first kiln-mode start
features.text: The first kiln-mode start no longer re-reads all of the game's data files; on one PC 2 min 40 s, in tests 30 s to 4 s.

features.title: Steam Deck and gamepads
features.text: Play's notices fold to one line so the mod list keeps room on a Steam Deck, and a gamepad stick let go no longer keeps scrolling Kiln's screens (thanks Somamint and Fuzen777).

features.title: EML mods after a leftover backup
features.text: A leftover modded backup of the game's data no longer makes every EML start fail; Kiln checks it first and makes a fresh one when that's provably safe (thanks potter420).

released.title: Kiln mode starts again
released.summary: A small patch: Kiln's interpreter for ShroudForge mods (kiln mode) starts again, and switching to it from the bundled ShroudForge no longer stops at the game data.

features.title: Kiln mode starts
features.text: Kiln's interpreter for ShroudForge mods was turned away at every start in 0.2.0-dev.30.2 and 30.3 (a missing build mark); it starts now, and the release checks refuse a build without the mark.

features.title: Switching to kiln mode
features.text: After Kiln's bundled ShroudForge, kiln mode puts the game's own data back when it can prove what the bundled ShroudForge wrote, and otherwise asks you to verify the game files in Steam.

released.title: EMF hits, more of ShroudForge on Kiln's engine, and new mod APIs
released.summary: EMF mods that react to hits, kiln mode running many more ShroudForge mods, mod API 0.2.13 (building input, Steam messages, game textures, item use, container names, outlines, pointer and drag and drop, recipe tank water) and fixes reported by players.

features.title: EMF mods that react to hits
features.text: EMF's on_hit and Lua's emf.on_hit report the hits the server applies, on Kiln's own EMF layer.

features.title: More of ShroudForge in kiln mode
features.text: Entities and components, the game's loaded resources, template components, the building cursor and props, and mod shortcuts work in kiln mode.

features.title: Kiln mode's own fallback notice
features.text: When Kiln's UI is missing, kiln mode still tells you which ShroudForge mods were skipped and why.

features.title: Chat history search
features.text: Ctrl+R searches your earlier chat lines in the HUD and Social chat (by bisdat).

features.title: Building input and Steam messages for mods
features.text: Mods can build as the local player, and talk over Steam's own peer-to-peer messages.

features.title: New mod APIs
features.text: Game textures in code, using an item for a player, renaming containers, outlining entities, the pointer and drag and drop, and recipe tank water.

features.title: Fixes from player reports
features.text: Items.Move never drops items into equipment slots, inventory marks are right at every resolution, Kiln's programs come back after a world change, and GameEvents lookups are cheap.

released.title: ShroudForge mods on Kiln's own engine and Crucible polish
released.summary: ShroudForge mods on Kiln's own engine as a choice in Settings, off by default (Kiln's bundled ShroudForge 1.8.1 stays the default); Crucible asks before a first share, installs a pack without playing and looks like Kiln; Kiln's overlay works next to ReShade; Pack Studio reads the game's items by itself.

features.title: ShroudForge mods on Kiln's own engine
features.text: Kiln can run ShroudForge mods (Lua packages, EML packages that need ShroudForge's runtime, and package DLLs made for ShroudForge 1.7.9) on its own engine. It is off by default: Kiln's bundled ShroudForge (1.8.1 since dev.30) stays the default, and kiln mode is a choice on the ShroudForge card in Settings.

features.title: EML packages and textures in kiln mode
features.text: In kiln mode, EML packages that need ShroudForge's runtime run on the same engine, and these packages can decode and encode game textures in Lua as ShroudForge's image functions do. Plain EML mods keep running on Kiln's EML engine as before.

features.title: Share to Crucible asks first
features.text: The first share of a profile shows what goes up (the mod list and files Crucible doesn't have yet), what stays on your PC (mod settings, your own data edits) and that saves are never sent; What is Crucible? explains the rest.

features.title: Install a pack without playing
features.text: The pack preview has Install next to Install and play: the pack becomes its own profile, named after the pack and its creator, without starting the game, even while Enshrouded runs.

features.title: Crucible looks like Kiln
features.text: Share, pack codes, the pack preview, updates and Pack Studio use Kiln's colours and plainer words; the preview shows Crucible's checks for packs from a code or link too.

features.title: A missing EMF mod is named before Play
features.text: An EMF mod whose required mod isn't installed says so on its row before you play, with how to get EMF's own mods such as lua.

features.title: Kiln's overlay next to ReShade
features.text: The overlay crash guard no longer turns Kiln's overlay off after ReShade's slow first frames, and an unseen Kiln menu falls back to the game's own Mods rows.

features.title: Pack Studio reads the game's items
features.text: Pack Studio reads the game's items when it opens, so the Items, Recipes and Loot pickers list them without a command-line step, and it hides the game's old and test entries unless you ask.

features.title: "Any of a group" recipe inputs
features.text: Pack Studio's recipe inputs can be any item of a group of the game's items, like any wood or any stone, chosen by typing any item of the group.

released.title: Clipboard prompt and ShroudForge's glider pitch
released.summary: A small patch: no clipboard permission prompt after updating, and ShroudForge 1.8's glider pitch works under Kiln.

features.title: No clipboard prompt after an update
features.text: The launcher no longer reads the clipboard when it starts or updates; Got a code? fills in a copied pack code without a permission prompt and has a Paste button.

features.title: ShroudForge's glider pitch under Kiln
features.text: ShroudForge 1.8's native glider pitch patch (Unlimited Flight's Upward Gliding) works under Kiln; Kiln's own glide steering hook now goes in only when a mod asks for it.

released.title: Crucible modpacks, equipment and the game's UI
released.summary: Crucible, modpacks on frostdev.io you share with a link or a code and install in two clicks, with Pack Studio for pack makers; an equipment API for item rarity, values, tooltips and upgrades; hooks into the game's own inventory screens and client hooks for mods; Kiln tasks in the main menu; ShroudForge 1.8.1 bundled; and signed Windows files.

features.title: Share your mods as a link
features.text: Share to Crucible turns a profile into a pack with a link and a short code for your friends; only files Crucible doesn't have yet are uploaded, and a changed profile updates the same link.

features.title: Install a pack from a code
features.text: A pack link or code shows the pack first (size, game build, a warning about other people's code), then installs it as a profile of its own, with your saves backed up first.

features.title: Pack updates keep your changes
features.text: Updates keep the settings you changed, the mods you added and your own data edits, ask when you and the creator changed the same setting, and can be undone.

features.title: Pack Studio
features.text: Pack makers build packs in the launcher: mods and optional mods, captured settings, data editors, load order and conflicts, a test copy, credits, and publishing link-only or public.

features.title: Packs are checked
features.text: Crucible checks every pack version on upload (structure, known-bad files, code, conflicting data), and the launcher runs the same checks on a pack file before it installs.

features.title: Crucible on frostdev.io
features.text: Public packs on frostdev.io with search and filters, pack pages with versions, credits, comments, upvotes and reports, and a Get Kiln button that opens the pack once Kiln is installed.

features.title: Your Crucible pack on Discord
features.text: An opt-in switch shows the Crucible pack you play on your Discord profile with a Get this modpack button, and a pack link pasted into Discord shows a card with its name and cover.

features.title: Packs on servers
features.text: A published pack goes onto one of your servers in one step, with its server mods and game settings, and joining players get its mods offered; passwords and bans never travel in a pack.

features.title: An item's rarity
features.text: Mods can read and set an item's rarity, its unlocked enhancements and its level, on the item itself.

features.title: Stronger single items
features.text: Mods can make one item stronger, tougher or longer lasting than others of its type, and it keeps that wherever it goes.

features.title: Any item value, with or without code
features.text: Data packs can set any item's values without code, in the numbers the tooltip shows (power, damage, armour, speed, perks, socket, durability), and mods can do the same from C#.

features.title: Modded values in the game's tooltips
features.text: The game's own item tooltips show modded values and extra lines from mods, in the game's colours.

features.title: Rarity upgrades
features.text: Mods can upgrade an item's rarity from code or with a station or forge action, at the cost and chance they choose; an upgraded item gets its next enhancement slot.

features.title: Rarity rolls at crafting and loot
features.text: Items a mod names can roll their rarity when they are crafted or found as loot.

features.title: Hooks into the game's own inventory screens
features.text: Mods can mark the game's inventory slots, take clicks on them that know the item they hold, and dock a panel with buttons beside the backpack and a chest's screen, knowing which chest is open.

features.title: Client hooks for mods
features.text: Mods can hook the game client's own code on players' games, with the same safety checks as server hooks, for what only a player's game does: its screens, input and what the player sees.

features.title: Kiln tasks, checked in a real game
features.text: Kiln tasks and their world reads and writes (since 0.2.0-dev.29.18) are checked on dedicated servers, on Windows and in a world you host. They stay experimental for now.

features.title: Kiln tasks in the main menu
features.text: Mods' tasks can hop to the main menu and run there while no world is loaded (GitHub #83).

features.title: Kiln's save writing on the task pool
features.text: Kiln's own save writing runs on Kiln's task pool, in the same order as before, with everything queued written whole when you quit.

features.title: Data conflicts between mods
features.text: Kiln's lint and the pack checks name every game value two mods set differently, and which one wins.

features.title: Signed Windows files
features.text: Kiln's Windows files are signed (Authenticode, publisher Frostdev), which should stop most antivirus false positives.

features.title: Joining a server with mod buffs
features.text: Joining a server whose mods add buffs works again; update Kiln on the server and on every player's game.

features.title: No freeze at a first start under Wine
features.text: A first start no longer freezes now and then under Wine or Proton while Kiln sets up its hooks.

features.title: Play once with EML mods on ShroudForge
features.text: Play once works again for a profile with Enshrouded ModLoader mods that run on ShroudForge.

features.title: Launcher fixes from player reports
features.text: Add Mod is no longer undone now and then, support reports are always written, the launcher no longer checks the game folder while in the background, and files still downloading are waited for. Thanks to HadToRegister.

features.title: X11 when the launcher is slow on Wayland
features.text: On Linux, the launcher restarts once through X11 when it can't use the GPU on Wayland, and remembers it; it can be turned off in Settings. Thanks to Oryx593.

features.title: ShroudForge 1.8.1
features.text: Kiln bundles ShroudForge 1.8.1 (was 1.7.9), so ShroudForge mods made for 1.8, like the current Unified Tweaks, run on Kiln; "Use my installed ShroudForge" also accepts 1.8.0 and 1.8.1.

released.title: A safer save editor
released.summary: The launcher's save editor in your language, read-only when it can't read a save for sure, other mods' hidden items shown as locked tiles, and the game's own skill-point count.

features.title: The save editor in your language
features.text: The editor's texts follow the launcher's 11 languages; item and skill names stay the game's.

features.title: No guessing at a backpack
features.text: A save the editor can't read for sure, or one holding another mod's data, opens read-only with the reason, so nothing is written at a guessed place.

features.title: Other mods' hidden items as locked tiles
features.text: An item Kiln doesn't know shows as a locked tile with a note naming its slot, and is kept untouched.

features.title: The game's own skill-point count
features.text: Available skill points are worked out the way the game does at each load, and a skill tree that spends more than that is not saved.

released.title: Chat completion and clearer reports
released.summary: Tab completion for Kiln's commands in the game's chat by bisdat, a view of what a support report holds before it leaves your PC, and fixes for ShroudLink, Enshrouded ModLoader's mods and the Linux launcher.

features.title: Tab completion in the game's chat, by bisdat
features.text: Start a chat line with / and Tab completes the Kiln commands you may use, on a server with Kiln or in your own hosted world. On by default.

features.title: See what is in a support report
features.text: Before a report is saved or sent, the launcher shows what it holds and what was replaced, and other mods' logs can be left out.

features.title: Support reports take out more personal details
features.text: Other players' names, IPv6, MAC and mail addresses, secrets in logs and more of your Steam names are replaced.

features.title: Removing a mod keeps its settings
features.text: Adding a removed mod again brings its settings back, and the remove dialog can take them out too, with a copy in Kiln's backups.

features.title: ShroudLink's chest names without endless scans
features.text: With Kiln, chest names come from the game's own name table, and a short search runs only for a name a mod asks for.

features.title: Enshrouded ModLoader's mods in the loader's order
features.text: Mods for Enshrouded ModLoader start in that loader's order, so CarryOn and Belt Lantern can run together.

features.title: A lighter Linux launcher without compositing
features.text: Where WebKit cannot composite, the launcher draws without blurred shadows, and launcher.log says why it does not composite.

features.title: A game build Kiln does not know
features.text: The guide says where the build Kiln checks comes from and what a player can do (GitHub #99).

released.title: FSR 4 without the extra extensions
released.summary: AMD FSR 4 runs on the game's graphics device without six Vulkan extensions Kiln added for it, a new try at its dark scenes, and a fix for Kiln tasks.

features.title: AMD FSR 4 should no longer draw dark scenes too dark
features.text: Kiln no longer adds six Vulkan extensions to the game's device for FSR 4, as in a working FSR 4 setup in this game. AMD FSR's Auto stays on FSR 3.1 until FSR 4 is confirmed on an RX 9000 card.

features.title: A Kiln task's crash stops its mod first
features.text: When a mod's task crashes, Kiln stops the mod's tasks before it reports the failure, so the mod can no longer start another task in between.

released.title: AMD FSR 3.1 by default
released.summary: AMD FSR's Auto runs FSR 3.1 until FSR 4 is confirmed in this game, and FSR 4 becomes an experimental choice of its own.

features.title: AMD FSR Auto runs FSR 3.1 for now
features.text: AMD FSR's Auto runs FSR 3.1 on every card until FSR 4 is confirmed in this game. FSR 4 stays a choice of its own, FSR 4 (experimental), which may render dark scenes too dark.

released.title: Other loaders and languages
released.summary: Mods for AndyPimms' Enshrouded ModLoader, Kiln with XHL-Core, station screens that count station outputs, nine more languages and fixes from players' reports.

features.title: Mods for AndyPimms' Enshrouded ModLoader
features.text: Mods for Enshrouded ModLoader, such as CarryOn and Belt Lantern, run in Kiln without that loader: add the zip and switch it on. Game client only, single player and hosting.

features.title: Kiln with XHL-Core
features.text: With XHL-Core installed, the main menu reads "Kiln with XHL-Core" and XHL-Core's warning line shows under it again; Kiln warns when one XHL mod is on twice.

features.title: Station screens count station outputs
features.text: On a Kiln client with a Kiln server, a production station's fill buttons and the Available counts include the finished items other stations lend (GitHub #68).

features.title: Nine more languages
features.text: Kiln in German, Russian, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Polish, Italian and Korean: machine translations, corrections welcome on GitHub (#90 to #98).

features.title: Kiln's language and keys for mods
features.text: Mods can read Kiln's language and listen to key and mouse presses through public API instead of reading Kiln's internals (mod API 0.2.11).

features.title: Resident tasks for native plugins
features.text: A native plugin can mark one long-lived task as resident (KILN_TASK_RESIDENT), so Kiln's watchdog does not report it as stuck; kiln.log notes when it starts.

features.title: AMD FSR on AMD cards
features.text: Kiln's AMD FSR runs on AMD graphics cards, and a change of upscaler applies at once while FSR 3 runs in a world (a choice that needs a game restart says so first).

features.title: AMD FSR 4 in dark scenes
features.text: FSR 4 measures the picture's exposure itself and gets new inputs for the game's dark scenes. Not yet confirmed on an RX 9000 card. FSR 3.1 stays a choice under AMD FSR version.

features.title: Hooks inside other mods' DLLs
features.text: A Kiln mod can hook code inside another mod's DLL once it opens it (Hooks.Module), for mods that extend other mods, such as a fix for Creative Mode's search.

features.title: The game's original code for native plugins
features.text: Native plugins can read the game's original code at an address and see whether another module patched it (kiln.hooks read_original and code_state).

features.title: ShroudLink's chest-name scan
features.text: ShroudLink's chest-name scan no longer makes the game stutter on PCs with few cores or a page file on a hard drive.

features.title: Client and server copies in one download
features.text: A download holding a game copy and a server copy of the same version, such as Town Portals, puts the game copy into your profile.

features.title: Discord's own refusals
features.text: When Discord itself refuses a support post, the launcher says so with Discord's reason.

features.title: A paused world is not a stall
features.text: Kiln's tick statistics tell a paused single-player world apart from a stall.

features.title: Open in Discord opens the app
features.text: "Open in Discord" on your support posts and test results opens the Discord app when it's installed, the browser otherwise.

features.title: A smoother launcher on Linux
features.text: The Linux launcher draws with the GPU's compositing again, so it stays smooth in large windows; if a PC can't start that way, it switches back by itself and remembers it.

features.title: A lighter launcher behind its pages
features.text: Behind an open page the launcher's fire draws only the header band, and without compositing the flames and torch hold still.

features.title: Clearer logs and reports for support
features.text: kiln.log names the file another mod's hook comes from, and support reports include Building Tools', ShroudLink's and Auto Loot Plus' logs.

features.title: No Nexus Mods choices without Nexus Mods
features.text: In builds with Nexus Mods switched off, a mod's Updates dialog offers only GitHub and the update hint no longer mentions a Nexus sign-in.

features.title: A warning before the game runs out of impact memory
features.text: kiln.log warns when the game's impact memory runs low and names what fills it, which helps find the cause of late-session slow motion and crashes.

features.title: The overlay's crash guard clears on update
features.text: A lock an older Kiln left after a failed overlay start no longer keeps the overlay off once you update.

released.title: Graphics tools, Kiln tasks and Discord
released.summary: Kiln in Simplified Chinese, Kiln's own graphics tools, a better upscaler behind the game's FSR 3, Kiln's Discord in the launcher, and Kiln tasks for mods' heavy work (mod API 0.2.10).

features.title: Kiln's graphics tools
features.text: A Graphics tab in Kiln's menu and the launcher: a frame cap, DLSS preset and render size, and a readout. They step aside for OptiScaler, DLSSTweaks and frame generation mods.

features.title: A better upscaler behind the game's FSR 3
features.text: With FSR 3 chosen in the game, Kiln can run AMD FSR 4, FSR 3.1 or Intel XeSS in its place; the files download in the launcher. FSR 4 and XeSS on an Intel card are not yet seen in a game.

features.title: Kiln tasks
features.text: Mods can run heavy work on Kiln's own worker threads and hand the result back to the game in small pieces, with world reads and writes from a task as an experimental API. Seen on a hosting client; dedicated servers and world writes wait for a game test.

features.title: Kiln's Discord in the launcher
features.text: A Community page brings the Kiln Discord into the launcher: Send to Kiln support, your posts and their replies, and Rich Presence. All of it optional.

features.title: Kiln in Simplified Chinese
features.text: The launcher and Kiln's own texts in the game in Simplified Chinese, translated by XiaoHuLi666 (XHL).

features.title: The game's own texts for mods
features.text: Client mods can read the text the game shows for any of its texts, and an item's tooltip rows, in the player's language.

features.title: Kiln beside OptiScaler
features.text: Kiln recognises OptiScaler under any of its names and keeps its overlay out of the way.

features.title: The overlay can't close the game
features.text: When Kiln's overlay cannot draw, the game keeps running; a launcher switch turns the overlay off.

features.title: One failing ShroudForge startup mod
features.text: When one of ShroudForge's startup mods fails, the others still apply.

features.title: EMF's Lua mods from EMF's download
features.text: Adding EMF's download in the launcher brings in its Lua mods.

features.title: Mods' programs in your own world
features.text: A mod's programs in the player's own world register and run, as checked in a real game.

features.title: Repair for removed Kiln files
features.text: When an antivirus removed one of Kiln's files, the launcher names it and offers Repair, and it says when an antivirus blocks an install.

features.title: Upscaler files download in the launcher
features.text: AMD's and Intel's upscaler files download in the launcher's Graphics settings and on the Deck.

features.title: Linux: an empty launcher window explained
features.text: When the launcher's page has not come up after 15 seconds, it says why instead of staying empty.

features.title: Linux: WebKit's sandbox, your choice
features.text: The launcher checks whether WebKit's sandbox can start on your system and lets you choose.

features.title: Linux: drawing without the GPU at start
features.text: "Draw the launcher without the GPU" is read at start again.

features.title: The launcher no longer lags
features.text: Pages open and typing keeps up on Linux PCs where the launcher's effects slowed it down.

features.title: A switch for Kiln's overlay
features.text: The launcher's Settings can turn Kiln's overlay off, also on Windows.

features.title: The crash guard watches a little longer
features.text: The overlay's crash guard also counts a game that closes during the overlay's first frames.

features.title: Kiln mods in EML's folder named
features.text: A Kiln mod unzipped into EML's mods folder is named as a Kiln mod, with where to add it.

features.title: No needless "One Steam setting" banner, by bisdat
features.text: On Linux with GE-Proton 11-11 or newer the launcher no longer asks for a Steam setting it doesn't need.

features.title: Switched-off ShroudForge mods stay off with XHL-Core
features.text: A ShroudForge mod that is also an XHL-Core plugin no longer runs through XHL-Core when it is off.

features.title: Play waits while a profile is applied
features.text: Play is held while the launcher writes your mods into the game folder.

features.title: Stop waiting when Steam does not start the game
features.text: The launcher stops waiting when Steam never starts the game, so Play comes back.

features.title: "Updated" for a newer file
features.text: Adding a newer version of a mod you have says "Updated" with both versions.

features.title: Antivirus blocks named
features.text: When an antivirus blocks Kiln's install, the launcher says so instead of only "Access is denied".

features.title: XHL-Core's log in support reports
features.text: Support reports include XHL-Core's own log, with your paths and names taken out.

features.title: ShroudForge settings on a Steam Deck SD card
features.text: ShroudForge mod settings changed in the game apply on a Steam Deck with the game on an SD card.

features.title: Changed mod copies are never lost silently
features.text: In copy mode a changed mod copy is never replaced without a word.

features.title: No read-only mod files
features.text: Mod files Kiln places are never read-only, so settings can be saved.

features.title: ShroudForge's errors count in kiln.log
features.text: ShroudForge's errors and warnings keep their level in kiln.log and support reports.

features.title: One row for a ShroudForge mod with an ini
features.text: A ShroudForge mod with a native-plugin.ini is listed once in the game's Mods page.

features.title: A server's mod hashes stay put
features.text: A server's ShroudForge and other engines' mods keep one hash while they run, so joining players' launchers can match them.

features.title: Tasks in unit tests
features.text: The test kit runs a mod's tasks on its own pool and can step a dedicated server, a hosting client or a joined client.

features.title: Analyzers for blocking waits
features.text: The analyzers warn about blocking waits in commands and chat handlers, and follow Kiln tasks.

features.title: Kiln's own steps at the game's exit
features.text: At a normal exit Kiln cancels queued tasks, closes the engine's write gate and parks the task pool, on native Windows too.

features.title: Wraps in the prediction storage
features.text: A wrap can run where the player's own client predicts their character, so a change shows on that player's screen.

features.title: Versions in support reports
features.text: A support report names Kiln's, the launcher's, the system's, Proton's or Wine's and the game's versions.

released.title: Custom game folders
released.summary: Play a copy of the game Steam doesn't know, station outputs as stock, a fix for stutters on hard drives, and more resource patches (mod API 0.2.9).

features.title: Custom game folders
features.text: The launcher can play a copy of Enshrouded that no Steam library knows, such as an older build or a copy on another drive, with the same profile, backups and reports.

features.title: Station outputs as stock
features.text: A production station can lend its finished items to its base, for fills and for players' crafts (GitHub #68, proposed by bisdat).

features.title: More resource patches
features.text: Resource patches can copy a component from another template, empty a list or set it exactly, and boot mods can read any resource.

features.title: kilnctl tick-compare
features.text: kilnctl compares two tick-stats files: step time, steps over budget and each mod's share (GitHub #57).

features.title: Other mods' slash commands
features.text: A chat line starting with / that names no Kiln command passes through to the game and other mods.

features.title: Stutters when hosting from a hard drive
features.text: kiln-emf and kiln.spawn write their files on a thread of their own, so a hosted world no longer stops for about 2 seconds every few minutes. Thanks to HadToRegister.

features.title: EMF's own break-blocks answer
features.text: EMF mods that ask why breaking blocks is unavailable get EMF's own "not available on this game version" (GitHub #43).

features.title: Clearer crash-guard lines
features.text: The overlay's crash-guard warning in kiln.log names the step that failed and the Windows error.

features.title: Large boot snapshots kept
features.text: A boot snapshot that grows past its size budget keeps working.

features.title: Ordinary chests in a fill
features.text: A station fill can name up to 64 ordinary chests of the base, used after the Magic chests.

features.title: Boot reads for any resource
features.text: Boot mods can list and read resources of any type, not only items and templates.

features.title: One DLL as Kiln mod and .asi
features.text: A documented pattern for one DLL that runs as a Kiln native mod and, without Kiln, as an .asi.

released.title: The game's look and your language
released.summary: Kiln's menus in the game's own look, Kiln ready for translations, the launcher's icon on Linux, faster starts on hard drives, and themes for mods' windows (mod API 0.2.8).

features.title: Kiln's menus in the game's look
features.text: Kiln's own windows use the game's colours and font, read from your game; a translucent look, Kiln's classic look or a mod's theme can be chosen.

features.title: Kiln in your language
features.text: The launcher and Kiln's in-game menus can be translated; Chinese, Japanese and Korean use the game's own fonts.

features.title: Themes for mods' windows
features.text: Mods can define a theme and a font for their own windows and offer the theme to the player.

features.title: Chat history, by bisdat
features.text: Up and Down in the game's chat bring back what you sent before. Off by default (pull request 63, GitHub #44).

features.title: The launcher's icon on Linux
features.text: The AppImage adds its own app-menu entry and icon, so Linux desktops show Kiln's icon.

features.title: Faster starts on hard drives
features.text: Kiln no longer freezes the loading screen for seconds on a PC with hard disks; its checks and small writes moved off the game's thread. Thanks to HadToRegister.

features.title: ShroudForge skips an unneeded rebuild
features.text: ShroudForge no longer applies its asset mods again at every start while nothing changed.

features.title: Linux: config edits stay
features.text: With a Flatpak or Snap Steam, a value set in the launcher's Configs page is no longer replaced by the game's older copy.

features.title: Kiln's mark back in the main menu
features.text: Kiln's mark is back before its line in the main menu.

features.title: Less disk writing with ShroudForge
features.text: ShroudForge's status file is written every 3 seconds instead of about 1.5 times a second.

features.title: Unreadable configs are never reset
features.text: A mod's config Kiln cannot read at start is left alone and read again, never overwritten with defaults.

features.title: Mods that only partly run say so
features.text: Mods whose own modified EML loader Kiln does not run are marked "Only partly runs", with what doesn't run.

features.title: Big worlds: less server time
features.text: A server step no longer scans every entity for players.

features.title: Trimmed icons and image parts
features.text: Mods can draw an item icon or image without its transparent margins, or a part of an image.

features.title: Blobs from any thread
features.text: Mods can read a resident blob from any thread without asking the game for its content index.

released.title: Item icons and chest gems
released.summary: Item icons and names for mod windows, mod panels at production stations, chest gems at the Shroud Forge and new kinds of boot patches (mod API 0.2.7).

features.title: Item icons and names in mod windows
features.text: Mods can show the game's own item icons and item names, in the player's language.

features.title: Chest gems at the Shroud Forge
features.text: With a mod that offers them, the gems in your chests show in the forge's own GEMS list, and a chest can pay the essence (GitHub #61, proposed by bisdat).

features.title: Mod panels at production stations
features.text: A mod's crafting panel can show next to a production station's screen, not only at a workbench.

features.title: More boot patches
features.text: Boot mods can append to a list, add and remove a template's components, and read names in OnBoot; a patch applies whole or not at all.

features.title: Expeditions finds your survivors
features.text: Expeditions (EMF) finds the survivors next to you again when you host your own world. Thanks to Spirimtin for testing.

features.title: Station and recipe names for mods
features.text: Mods get stations' and recipes' names in the player's language, and a base's stock including outputs still in its stations.

features.title: More images in mod windows
features.text: The overlay holds up to 960 images: fonts, mods' pictures and item icons together.

released.title: Production stations
released.summary: Production stations for mods (mod API 0.2.6).

features.title: Production stations for mods
features.text: Mods can keep a base's kilns, smelters, looms and other production stations going: fill them from the base's Magic chests as the game's own button does, stop and start them, pick their recipe and collect what they made.

features.title: Bases for mods
features.text: Mods can list every base with its altars, Magic chests, water sources and stock, and hear when altars are added, removed, merged or split.

features.title: A station's craft counts once
features.text: For mods that watch crafting, a production station's cycle counts once, when the items are made.

features.title: Stations for mods: reads and actions
features.text: Mods can read a station's state, recipe, progress, inputs and outputs, plan and fill it, stop, resume, select a recipe and collect, and hear players' button presses there, which they can cancel.

released.title: Skill Search and the Ping System
released.summary: Skill Search and the In Game Ping System work again.

features.title: Skill Search and the In Game Ping System
features.text: Both halves of an EML mod with a Shroudtopia module beside it run, so Skill Search's search box and the Ping System's markers are back.

released.title: EMF 0.6.14 and linked game folders
released.summary: A game folder that is a link works again, mods for EMF 0.6.14 start, and Kiln's windows take no stray clicks from play.

features.title: A game folder that is a link
features.text: A game folder that is a link or junction (a moved Steam library) works again.

features.title: Mods for EMF 0.6.14
features.text: Mods built with EMF 0.6.13 and 0.6.14 start on Kiln, EMF's Lua mod among them. The seven functions EMF added there answer as EMF documents when a feature isn't there yet (GitHub #43).

features.title: Kiln's windows take no stray clicks
features.text: A click made just before a Kiln window opened, or during a hitch, no longer presses a button in it, and the cursor no longer jumps after a hitch.

features.title: Steam's own DLL named in reports
features.text: Support reports call steam_api64.dll Steam's own Steamworks DLL instead of an unknown DLL.

released.title: Gems
released.summary: The gem system for mods (mod API 0.2.5) and Kiln on the main menu.

features.title: Gems for mods
features.text: Mods can read gems, make new ones with their own names, icons and effects (a game gem's program or C# code), and run the Shroud Forge's socket, unsocket, upgrade and recycle from code with its rules and costs.

features.title: Sockets on more gear
features.text: Mods can let rings, armour and shields have a gem socket, and give an existing piece one. The Shroud Forge lists them on Kiln clients.

features.title: The Gem Forge's list for mods
features.text: Client mods can read the list of gems the Shroud Forge shows (GitHub #42).

features.title: Kiln on the main menu
features.text: The main menu shows Kiln's mark, its version and how many mods started, in the game's own footer style.

features.title: Switched-off mods no longer lock you out
features.text: A mod switched off in the profile no longer counts as a mod players need, so a hosted world or a server no longer refuses players over it.

features.title: Greeneye mods when a thread can't be opened
features.text: Greeneye mods start on PCs where security software holds a thread of the game, as Greeneye Loader does itself.

features.title: A mod's gem stays itself
features.text: A gem from a removed mod stays in your inventory or socket as a "[Missing: …]" placeholder instead of turning into its base gem.

features.title: Gem events
features.text: Mods hear when a socketed gem does something and when a socket is filled, emptied or upgraded.

features.title: Items with a program from kiln.assets
features.text: An item whose Impact program a mod serves through kiln.assets is accepted.

released.title: Mods for CharosDX's loader
released.summary: Mods made for CharosDX's loader are added as mods, and you can read again what an add left out.

features.title: Mods for CharosDX's loader
features.text: Sparkworks Enhanced, Cross-Base Storage and Craft From Stations are added to the Library as mods; their own loader isn't needed.

features.title: What an add left out
features.text: The message after Add mods stays while something was left out, and Last adds shows your last 10 adds with their details.

released.title: Unbind keys
released.summary: Keys can be unbound in Kiln's menu, and kiln.log records what EMF mod windows do.

features.title: Unbind a key
features.text: Each action on the Keys page of Kiln's menu has an Unbind button.

features.title: EMF windows in kiln.log
features.text: kiln.log notes when an EMF mod opens a window, what it lists, each click and when it closes, so a support report shows it.

released.title: Clearer reports
released.summary: Clearer XHL and EML lines, and support reports that show where other mods changed the game's code.

features.title: XHL plugins under XHL-Core
features.text: XHL plugins no longer say "Requires XHL-Core" while XHL-Core runs; the line says where XHL-Core's own log is.

features.title: Code changes in support reports
features.text: Support reports list each place where another mod changed the game's code, and which module did it, so two mods changing one spot are easy to find.

features.title: Skipped EML mods in support reports
features.text: The support report says "on, not applied" with the reason for an EML mod Kiln could not apply, instead of "off".

released.title: Creative menu for the host
released.summary: The Creative menu is there for the host again, mods Kiln places in the game folder show as running, and a clearer note when ShroudForge is switched off.

features.title: Creative menu for the host
features.text: In a world your game hosts, the pause menu has its Creative entry from the start again.

features.title: Game-folder mods show as running
features.text: Mods Kiln places in the game folder for the game to load show "Runs from the game folder" instead of "Will not run" (GitHub #41).

features.title: Why ShroudForge is off
features.text: EML mods that need ShroudForge say that the KILN_SHROUDFORGE environment variable switched it off, and how to remove it (GitHub #36).

released.title: Item Skill Descriptions beside Auto Doors
released.summary: Item Skill Descriptions and Auto Doors run side by side.

features.title: Item Skill Descriptions beside Auto Doors
features.text: Item Skill Descriptions and Auto Doors run side by side: the tooltips show the skill text and the doors open. Shroudlink's K tab keeps working next to both.

released.title: Auto Doors
released.summary: A quick fix for Auto Doors next to Item Skill Descriptions.

features.title: Auto Doors with Item Skill Descriptions on
features.text: Auto Doors works again when Item Skill Descriptions is also on.

released.title: Loaders from the game folder
released.summary: Plugin-loader and Ultimate ASI Loader mods run from the game folder, and Kiln names the Shroudlink core file that stops your Shroudlink mods.

features.title: Plugin loaders in the game folder
features.text: Mods that only work from the game folder, such as the powrprof.dll loader of "Autoloot and coop loot sharing", are placed there when switched on and taken out when switched off. Your own files there are never replaced.

features.title: Ultimate ASI Loader and .asi mods
features.text: Ultimate ASI Loader and .asi mods such as Smart Workshop come from the Library like other mods; Kiln places the loader next to the game so Kiln's own dinput8.dll stays.

features.title: Shroudlink core file named
features.text: When an old shroudlink_core.dll in the game folder stops your profile's Shroudlink mods, the launcher, kiln.log and support reports say to remove it.

features.title: Careful with your files in the game folder
features.text: Kiln writes into the game folder only where there is no file or its own copy is, removes only its own unchanged files, and settles an interrupted change at the next activation.

released.title: Autosaves and keys
released.summary: Autosaves no longer hitch on a hard drive, one key press counts once, and Quick Deposit and Shroudlink work beside other mods.

features.title: Autosaves on hard drives
features.text: Kiln.Saves does its file work on its own thread, so a hosted world or a server keeps running through an autosave on a hard drive (GitHub issue #39).

features.title: One key press counts once
features.text: A key press counts once, also when the game loses the keyboard focus for a moment, so a mod's window no longer opens and closes again at once.

features.title: Quick Deposit's keys
features.text: Quick Deposit's keys work when Kiln runs Greeneye's mods.

features.title: Shroudlink's K tab beside Auto Doors
features.text: Shroudlink's K tab works with Auto Doors installed.

features.title: A mod's own log is not a change
features.text: A DLL mod that writes its own log beside its DLL no longer shows "Changed on disk" in the Library.

features.title: Overlay back after a frame-generation mod
features.text: Kiln's overlay tries again after you remove a frame-generation or other graphics wrapper.

features.title: A key's release with a text field focused
features.text: A key's release reaches a mod also while one of its text fields has the focus.

released.title: XHL mods stay off
released.summary: Switched-off XHL mods stay off, the first open of the mods page no longer stalls a hard drive, and the launcher no longer suggests copying a loader over Kiln.

features.title: Switched-off XHL mods stop
