features.text: An XHL mod you switch off in Kiln no longer keeps loading through XHL-Core. Its changed settings wait in Kiln and come back when you switch it on; when Kiln cannot stop one, the launcher says why.

features.title: Mods page on a hard drive
features.text: The first open of Kiln's mods page no longer stalls the game for seconds on a hard drive.

features.title: No loader over Kiln's dinput8.dll
features.text: The Library no longer suggests copying another loader over Kiln's own dinput8.dll, and names the supported way.

features.title: Settings that come back are named
features.text: When a mod's kept settings come back, the launcher says so and where they came from.

features.title: No warning about a switched-off mod's folder
features.text: kiln.log no longer warns that a switched-off mod's folder is missing.

released.title: Joining a Kiln world
released.summary: A quick fix: players with Kiln can join a world run by Kiln again.

features.title: Joining a Kiln world
features.text: Players with Kiln can join a world a friend hosts or a Kiln dedicated server again; in 0.2.0-dev.29 they were turned away after a few seconds. Update Kiln on both sides.

released.title: Hooks, events and limits
released.summary: Boot mods in players' games, events mods can refuse, wraps of the game's own systems, typed hooks and higher limits; and fixes from players' reports: ShroudForge spawning, EML mods with their own DLL on Windows, frame generation mods, the pause menu and autosave hitches on hard drives.

features.title: Boot mods in your game
features.text: Boot mods such as More Flame Altars work in a world you host and when you join a server, with no setting. Seen in a hosted world; joining a server still waits for a game test.

features.title: Boot mods compared at the join
features.text: When you join a server, Kiln checks that each boot mod you share made the same game data as on the server, and names the mod when your settings differ.

features.title: Roll back a mod update
features.text: Updating a mod keeps the version you had: its menu offers to roll back to it, with the settings it had.

features.title: Replace a mod's DLL
features.text: A DLL mod's menu can swap in a patched DLL from its author. The mod keeps its place, its switch and its settings, and the build you had is kept. Not yet tried on Windows.

features.title: Restore the game's data
features.text: When files another mod loader left in the game folder stop Kiln's EML mods, the launcher offers to move them aside, with an undo.

features.title: Why a start was stopped
features.text: When Kiln stops a start to keep a world's mod progress safe, the launcher says why and names the mods.

features.title: Clear buttons in filter boxes
features.text: The launcher's filter and search boxes get a clear (X) button, and Esc empties them.

features.title: ShroudForge running on its own
features.text: When ShroudForge's own loader runs its mods, the launcher says so, names the file and shows the way back to the profile deciding.

features.title: Wrap the game's systems
features.text: Mods can run code before, after or instead of the game's own systems, for each entity, without patching the game's code, and can add systems of their own.

features.title: Typed function hooks
features.text: Advanced mods can hook game functions with typed arguments, including floats and structs, and Kiln checks each against the running game before it goes in.

features.title: Cancelable events
features.text: Mods can refuse a death, a walk-over pickup or an equipment change, and watch health, stamina, mana and inventories change.

features.title: Faster Impact natives
features.text: A mod's own Impact natives can answer in the same step, attach to the game's own scripts without copying them, and run first in a weapon's or a perk's hit.

features.title: Programs in the client world
features.text: Client mods can run programs in the player's own game world, on a hosted or a joined game.

features.title: Equipment set swaps
features.text: Mods can swap a player's gear as one set: every slot changes or none does.

features.title: More buffs and world programs
features.text: Mods together can clone 4,096 buffs (1,024 before), Kiln and mods together can register 64 world programs (32 before), and mods can ask how much room is left.

features.title: Larger NPC roster
features.text: Mods together can add up to 93 roster NPCs instead of 29.

features.title: VFX budget
features.text: Mods can read how much room for VFX is left and get a clear answer when they define one. The room itself stays as it is in this release.

features.title: Material sets for new shapes
features.text: Mods can give a new building shape its own set of materials in the build menu.

features.title: EMF programs in your own world
features.text: EMF mods' programs and events run in the player's own game world too, hosted or joined.

features.title: Hooks only when needed
features.text: Kiln hooks the game's building, crafting, spawning and entity functions only when a mod uses them, and leaves them untouched for other loaders otherwise.

features.title: ShroudForge mods that spawn things
features.text: ShroudForge mods that spawn things into the world, such as SpiderHook's grapple, work under Kiln again when none of your Kiln mods uses building events: Kiln no longer hooks those game functions unless a mod needs them. Beside a Kiln mod that does, ShroudForge's search should now find the spawn code anyway (thanks to AlexK-Notable's fix); not yet seen in a game.

features.title: EML mods that need ShroudForge
features.text: EML mods that bring a DLL for ShroudForge to load, such as Quiver & Spellbook, run whole: Kiln starts ShroudForge for them, or skips them with the reason, never half.

features.title: EML mods with their own DLL on Windows
features.text: With ShroudForge mods in the profile, EML mods that bring their own DLL (Auto Loot Plus, Endless Chests) switch on.

features.title: Auto Loot Plus next to Ultimate ASI Loader
features.text: Kiln keeps Auto Loot Plus (installed from its package) ahead of Ultimate ASI Loader, so its F8 menu comes up. Its looting needs a build for the current game version.

features.title: Shroudtopia mods that are only a DLL
features.text: They switch on with the profile, and the in-game list says where an off Shroudtopia mod is switched off.

features.title: EMF windows fit their content
features.text: An EMF mod's window, such as the Beastmaster stable, grows with what is in it up to most of the screen, then scrolls.

features.title: Frame generation mods
features.text: Frame generation mods (NVIDIA Streamline) no longer crash the game at start: Kiln's overlay drawing steps aside, and mods' keys, menu entries and loading keep working. While Streamline is installed, mod windows and on-screen drawing are off.

features.title: EML failures say why
features.text: When Kiln's EML loader cannot prepare the game's data, the log and each mod's status name the step and the cause.

features.title: Start display while you play
features.text: The launcher no longer says Kiln has said nothing for a whole session while you play.

features.title: Several chained DLL mods in the game's list
features.text: Each chained dinput8.dll mod gets its own row in Kiln's in-game list, without the ImGui popup.

features.title: The pause menu fits the screen
features.text: The pause menu scrolls when Kiln's and other mods' entries make it taller than the screen, so Quit to Desktop stays reachable at every resolution.

features.title: Autosave hitches on hard drives
features.text: The game no longer slows or freezes at each autosave on a hard drive: when no mod data changed, Kiln writes nothing during the save (GitHub issue #39).

features.title: NoClip follows rules.json
features.text: /noclip follows "allowNoClip" in the server's rules.json even when no mod has applied rules yet, and picks up edits to the file (thanks to bisdat).

features.title: Shroudlink mods without the client addon
features.text: The mods list says when Shroudlink mods run without Shroudlink's client addon, so its in-game MODS tab is missing, and offers to switch the addon on.

features.title: One broken mod no longer takes the others' NPCs
features.text: A mod with a broken kiln.mod.json is left out on its own and named in the log; the other mods' NPCs, quests and knowledge are still built.

features.title: Too many VFX no longer crash the start
features.text: Kiln counts every mod's VFX against the game's table, refuses what does not fit and names the mod, instead of the game crashing at start.

features.title: Boot mods' own icons
features.text: Items and talents a boot mod makes show their own icon from the first start.

features.title: Linux: Ultimate ASI Loader next to Kiln
features.text: The Steam launch option names xinput9_1_0 too, and Kiln's logs say when Wine loaded its own copy of a chained DLL.

released.title: OnBoot
released.summary: Mods put their content, and their changes to the game's own data, in place before the game reads them: on a dedicated server's very first start now, in players' games after its game test. Also questions about the world and paths, terrain overlays, weapon follow-ups, tool wear, block kinds of your own, creature control, mod update checks and kiln publish.

features.title: Content on the first start
features.text: Mods can add items, spells, statuses, effects and talents that exist from a server's first start, with no second restart. Until the game test, players' games do not load such mods, so a server whose players need one refuses Kiln players.

features.title: Change the game's own data
features.text: Boot mods can change values the game reads once at start, such as experience per level or how many Flame Altars a base may have.

features.title: Settings in OnBoot
features.text: A boot mod can read its own settings in OnBoot, so a level cap or an altar count can come from them. KilnBoot in the SDK makes a project a boot mod.

features.title: Mod update checks
features.text: Players can check for newer versions of their mods in the launcher, by hand or once a day. Nothing is downloaded or installed for you.

features.title: Publish with kiln publish
features.text: Mod authors can release a packed mod as a GitHub release: the zip is checked first, and nothing is sent until you confirm.

features.title: Questions about the world
features.text: Server mods can cast rays, find the ground, check line of sight and find nearby entities, and creature brains can stop seeing through walls.

features.title: Path search
features.text: Server mods can ask the game's own path search for a walking route, or only whether a place can be reached.

features.title: Terrain overlays
features.text: Mods can add ore veins, mounds, tunnels and small landforms that stay after a restart and that players without the mod also see.

features.title: Weapon follow-up moves
features.text: A weapon's moves can lead into each other, for example a block that goes on into the weapon's own parry.

features.title: Tool wear
features.text: Mods can make an axe or pickaxe wear faster, slower or not at all.

features.title: Values in the game's UI
features.text: Client mods can show their own numbers and bars in the game's item details, inventory slots and health, stamina and mana display.

features.title: Block kinds of your own
features.text: A mod can add a kind of block of its own that other mods then write in C# or JSON.

features.title: Creature control
features.text: Server mods can take over a creature's movement from the game's AI and give it back afterwards.

features.title: Prop scale that lasts
features.text: Mods can resize props per axis, and the size stays after a restart. It changes how big a prop looks, not its collision.

features.title: List of content files
features.text: Mods can list every content file the game serves, the game's own and every mod's, and where each comes from.

features.title: Game types by script name
features.text: Mods can find game types by the names Impact scripts use.

features.title: Join check at the door
features.text: A joining player can be held at the door for up to 25 s while the server checks their game, then let in or refused with a reason. Kiln's own services use it now; mods get it through later ones.

features.title: Newer EMF mods load
features.text: EMF mods made for EMF 0.6.9 to 0.6.11 start on Kiln, also those that ask for the newer EMF versions.

features.title: Held features and preview
features.text: Features that still need a real-game test ship switched off and say so; a preview setting switches them on for testing.

features.title: Beside in-place patches
features.text: Kiln mods keep working when another loader changed the game's code before Kiln started; before, some Kiln features switched off.

features.title: Beside other hook engines
features.text: Kiln recognises the hooks other engines put into the game's code, such as greeneye plugins and XHL mods, and keeps working beside them. By rifters (pull request 31).

features.title: NoClip descent and return
features.text: In NoClip and character flight, holding sneak always sinks; a player who left inside the ground returns at their last free position.

features.title: Key bindings
features.text: Keys with no name of their own keep their binding after a restart, and punctuation keys work on non-US keyboard layouts. The restart fix is by bisdat (pull request 34).

features.title: Temporary terrain
features.text: Temporary terrain from mods no longer stays in your save when it was made inside a base or in a second world.

features.title: Creature brains walk
features.text: A creature run by a mod's own brain now walks; before, the game's steering kept it standing still.

features.title: Required boot mods stop on a bad entry
features.text: A required boot mod with a bad entry in its own files stops the start and names the file and the entry, instead of loading a world without it.

features.title: EML mod message
features.text: If ShroudForge keeps an EML mod you copied in by hand switched off, Kiln now says so and how to switch it on.

features.title: Start bar while the game data is made
features.text: The start bar no longer sticks at Starting while the launcher makes the game data for boot mods (once per game update, about a minute): that step shows its own progress now.

features.title: Play once with boot mods
features.text: Play once makes the game-data snapshot too, so a boot mod that reads the game's data finds it ready.

features.title: Data folder move
features.text: Moving the data folder, or using an existing one, is no longer refused now and then as if another launcher were using it.

features.title: Long prerelease numbers
features.text: Update checks compare very long prerelease numbers by their value.

features.title: kiln lint patterns
features.text: kiln lint no longer rejects every publish tag and two folder-name fields.

features.title: Game systems by name
features.text: A directory of the game's ECS programs, for program wraps in a later release.

features.title: Typed hooks
features.text: Hooks whose signature is checked against the game's code at load.

features.title: Owner cleanup notices
features.text: Native services are told when a mod's ownership of something ends.

features.title: Network inspector
features.text: The start of a tool that shows what a server sends each player.

features.title: Capacity budgets
features.text: One shared way for Kiln to report how much room is left under a limit.

released.title: NoClip and EMF v40
released.summary: NoClip arrives as a rule of its own, and mods get the calls they were missing: buffs, kicks and bans, equipment, weather, item bonuses and more. EMF mods made for EMF 0.6.3 and later start on Kiln again.

features.title: NoClip for admins
features.text: Admins can use /noclip to fly through the ground and walls. It is off until the server allows it, and ends on death or teleport.

features.title: NoClip rule for mods
features.text: Mods can switch NoClip on for a player. When it ends inside something, the character is put back where it was last free.

features.title: Kick and ban commands
features.text: Servers get Kiln's own /kick, /ban (with an optional duration), /unban and /bans commands, and mods can refuse a player at login.

features.title: Remove and list buffs
features.text: Mods can take a buff off a player, creature or NPC, and list the buffs an entity has.

features.title: Where a player looks
features.text: Mods can read where a player's camera is and the direction it looks, on the server.

features.title: Equip and unequip items
features.text: Mods can put an item from a player's backpack on, or take one off, using the game's own equip checks.

features.title: Choose the weather
features.text: Mods can start a weather type such as rain for a set time or hold it, and follow every weather change.

features.title: Rolled item bonuses
features.text: Mods can define affixes and roll them onto single items. All 39 of the game's stats work while the item is held or worn.

features.title: Item data in players' games
features.text: A value a mod keeps on one item can now be sent to the player holding it, or to players nearby.

features.title: Saved world writes
features.text: Mods can change an entity's component so the change is saved with the world and kept after a restart.

features.title: Events for one entity
features.text: Mods can listen to the events of one entity only, so a mod watching one dummy no longer holds every hit in the world.

features.title: Mouse key bindings
features.text: Key bindings can use the side buttons, the middle button and the wheel, with Ctrl, Shift or Alt.

features.title: Scrolling pause menu
features.text: The pause menu scrolls when mods add many entries, and every mod's entry is also on Kiln's Mods page.

features.title: EMF 0.6.3 to 0.6.8 mods
features.text: EMF mods made for EMF 0.6.3 to 0.6.8 start on Kiln again, including Lua mods. Kiln serves EMF API v40.

features.title: EMF server mod check
features.text: A Kiln game answers an EMF server's mod check, so such servers no longer kick Kiln players after a minute.

features.title: Start progress on Play
features.text: Pressing Play shows each step of the start until the main menu, and from the second start, how long is left.

features.title: Launcher cooks mods
features.text: Mods with a cook recipe are cooked when you press Play. The launcher brings the cook tools, and on Windows its own Python.

features.title: Act on several mods
features.text: You can tick several mods and switch them on, off or remove them at once. All on and All off come with Undo.

features.title: Edited mod folders
features.text: A mod you edited in its own folder shows as changed on disk, and one click keeps your edit as the mod's files.

features.title: Save editor on Steam Deck
features.text: The save editor works with the controller alone on the Steam Deck, keeps unsaved changes and no longer overwrites newer saves.

features.title: ShroudForge loader warnings
features.text: When ShroudForge's own loader cannot write its mods into the game data, the launcher names the mods and says what to change.

features.title: Definitions baked at build
features.text: Quests, NPCs, dialogues, VFX and materials defined in code are written into the mod at build, so they exist from the first start.

features.title: Cook records
features.text: Kiln records what each cook wrote and warns about cooked files a mod shipped instead of cooking them on the machine.

features.title: One answer style everywhere
features.text: Every service now reports results and unavailable features the same way, with an event for each change Kiln makes.

features.title: Test kit fakes more
features.text: Mods can test spawning, chat, items, combat, time, quests and talent trees under dotnet test, without the game.

features.title: New samples and templates
features.text: New sample mods and dotnet new templates cover saved data, admin tools, events, rules, networking, hooks, shaders and more.

features.title: New analyzer warnings
features.text: The analyzers warn about a Kiln result nobody reads, and about a capability-dependent call with no check first.

features.title: Server start progress
features.text: A dedicated server writes the start step it is in, with what each step took, to a progress file.

features.title: Faster material loading
features.text: Starts with many mod materials are much faster, and unchanged materials are reused from the last start.

features.title: Save editor stack amounts
features.text: The save editor no longer stops item amounts at the game's stack size when a mod raises stack sizes.

features.title: No hang with other loaders
features.text: The game no longer hangs at start when other loaders load their libraries at the same time. A community contribution.

features.title: Mods next to early hooks
features.text: Kiln's mods load again next to mods that hook the game before Kiln, such as Auto Doors with Greeneye Loader or ShroudForge.

features.title: MODS entry with ShroudForge
features.text: The game's main menu has its MODS entry again when Kiln runs ShroudForge.

features.title: Mod settings sliders
features.text: Applied mod settings show at once in the game, and sliders have a number field to type a value.

released.title: Item data and weapon moves
released.summary: The first of the releases that complete the mod API: data on single items, weapons with their own attacks, typed game data and offline tests. Players can move Kiln's data folder to another drive.

features.title: Data on one item
features.text: Mods can keep a value on one particular item, such as kills on one sword, through moves, saves and restarts.

features.title: Weapons with their own moves
features.text: Mods can give weapons their own attacks, blocks and casts, with timing and chains, and held models that animate.

features.title: Player animation states
features.text: Mods can add player animation states, placed like the game's attacks, dodges or casts, to the player's animation graph.

features.title: Capabilities table
features.text: Mods can ask what works on the current game build and side, and why not. A list is also written for support.

features.title: Typed game data
features.text: Mods can read every game component and event through typed structs, checked against the running game before use.

features.title: Unit tests without the game
features.text: A new test template loads a mod through Kiln's real loader under dotnet test, with fake players and saved data.

features.title: Guided client checks
features.text: Mod authors can write checks a tester plays in the game, with keys to record pass, fail or skip.

features.title: Stable mod API 0.2.1
features.text: The mod API is 0.2.1. Kiln's build now fails if shipped API is removed or changed, and lab-only helpers are hidden.

features.title: SDK feed and API site
features.text: The SDK is published as a NuGet feed, and the API reference and modder's guide are published as a site.

features.title: Move the data folder
features.text: The launcher can move everything Kiln keeps to another folder or drive, checking the copy before it switches.

features.title: Quieter mod folder notices
features.text: Notices about mod folders come once instead of at every change, and a Notes view shows them again.

features.title: Cooking for servers
features.text: kiln cook works against a dedicated server's files and cooks what the server needs, skipping models.

features.title: Mod creature factions
features.text: Mod creatures keep their own friends and foes again, instead of fighting by the game's normal factions.

features.title: Attacks in a second world
features.text: Mods' own attack sequences keep working after quitting to the menu and loading another world.

features.title: Clips on game skeletons
features.text: Animations made on a game skeleton no longer tear the character's body apart while they play.

features.title: Item data after rejoin
features.text: Data a mod keeps on an item in your inventory comes back when you rejoin while wearing gear.

features.title: Other DLL loaders
features.text: Kiln no longer mistakes another tool's proxy DLL for Shrouded Engine Tweaks, and no longer starts a Shroudtopia mod twice.

released.title: ShroudForge and XHL hotfix
released.summary: A hotfix for dev.24: ShroudForge and EML mods together, XHL mods, a missing search box, and a launcher window that stayed black on some Linux machines.

features.title: Black window fallback
features.text: When the launcher's page does not come up, it starts again without the GPU. A setting turns this on or off.

features.title: XHL-Core 2.x recognised
features.text: The launcher recognises XHL-Core 2.x as one mod that updates in place, instead of adding a new mod per download.

features.title: ShroudForge data mods next to EML
features.text: ShroudForge's data mods apply again when EML mods are on too, such as Unlock Blueprints with More Gliders.

features.title: XHL mods import
features.text: XHL mods that carry a small mod.json import again and are placed where XHL-Core loads them.

features.title: XHL-Core starts its mods
features.text: XHL-Core now starts its plugins under Kiln, so XHL mods and their settings appear.

features.title: Skill Search box
features.text: Skill Search's search box shows again: Kiln now loads the Shroudtopia module in folders that also hold an EML part.

released.title: One list of all mods
released.summary: Mostly built from player reports: the launcher shows every mod in one list, mods of other loaders really run, and nothing of yours is deleted along the way.

features.title: One list of all mods
features.text: The main screen lists every mod you added, for any loader, plus hand-installed ones, each with an on/off switch.

features.title: Profiles in Settings
features.text: Kiln keeps your mods in one profile by itself. Several named profiles are still available in Settings.

features.title: One-click remove
features.text: Removing a mod is one click. Typing the mod's name to confirm is now an option in Settings.

features.title: Your mod files are kept
features.text: Files a mod wrote into its folder are carried over at updates and kept when the mod is switched off or Kiln is removed.

features.title: DLL mod updates replace
features.text: An update of a DLL mod replaces the old version instead of becoming a second entry.

features.title: ShroudForge mods in game
features.text: Kiln's in-game Mods menu has a page for each ShroudForge mod, with its switch, settings and buttons.

features.title: ShroudForge mod shortcuts
features.text: Shortcuts of ShroudForge mods work with the ShroudForge that Kiln brings along.

features.title: EML mods with ShroudForge
features.text: EML mods run when a ShroudForge mod is on too, and the launcher says why when one does not.

features.title: Other loaders' own folders
features.text: Flame, Greeneye, XHL and SET 0.2 mods run from the folders where they keep their files and settings.

features.title: Steered creative glider
features.text: In creative mode, S raises the glider's nose and W lowers it. Server owners can switch this off.

features.title: Enshwick packs import
features.text: Data packs written like Enshwick's own examples import instead of being refused as invalid.

features.title: Play with Steam closed
features.text: On the Linux AppImage, Play works when Steam was closed, instead of every start ending within seconds.

features.title: Adding mods on Steam Deck
features.text: Adding mods on a Steam Deck with ShroudForge installed works again.

features.title: Mods entry with ShroudForge
features.text: Kiln's Mods entry is back in the main menu when ShroudForge mods are on.

features.title: Mods page next to overlays
features.text: The in-game Mods page is no longer empty next to ReShade or another graphics overlay.

released.title: Server page and Shroudlink fixes
released.summary: Launcher fixes for dedicated servers, a Shroudlink client fix and an Enshwick update.

features.title: Shroudlink modules apart
features.text: Shroudlink's singleplayer zip imports each module (Storage, Assistants, Chestsort and others) as its own Library entry.

features.title: Enshwick alpha.14
features.text: The bundled runtime uses Enshwick 1.0.0-alpha.14.

features.title: Two admin mods warning
features.text: Kiln.Admin warns in the log when another admin mod answers the same folder.

features.title: Servers page after start
features.text: The Servers page no longer fails after a start on a server that runs another admin Lua mod.

features.title: No rewrite loop after update
features.text: An old launcher left running after an update no longer rewrites the game's profile in turns with the new one.

features.title: Shroudlink MODS tab
features.text: Kiln no longer fights Shroudlink's client addon over the game window, which could lose the game's window.

released.title: Mods that did not load
released.summary: Built around reports of other frameworks' mods being refused, hidden or never run. Adds a mod manager inside the game, a support report, and a much faster first start.

features.title: In-game mod manager
features.text: MODS in the game's main menu opens a page listing the mods of every framework, their state and reasons, with search.

features.title: Support report
features.text: The Logs page saves one zip with logs and a plain summary, with names, paths, ids and tokens removed.

features.title: Mods as they are shared
features.text: The Library accepts other frameworks' mods with their own ids and files as they are, instead of refusing them.

features.title: 7z and rar archives
features.text: The launcher reads 7z archives, and rar archives when a tool such as 7-Zip or unrar is installed.

features.title: Game-folder packages
features.text: Packages shaped like the game folder, and DLL mods with their data files, import as the right mods.

features.title: Mods in the game folder
features.text: The launcher lists mods you extracted into the game folder, whether they load, and adds them in one click.

features.title: Drop-in switch per framework
features.text: Profile settings have a drop-in folder switch for EML, ShroudForge, Greeneye, Flame, Shroudtopia, Enshwick and shroudlink.

features.title: Mods load with any loader
features.text: When another framework's own loader is installed, the launcher copies profile mods where it reads them. A mod never runs twice.

features.title: Data-only mods
features.text: A Kiln mod can be data only, with a manifest and content files and no code to run.

features.title: Faster first start
features.text: The first start with EML mods no longer reads all game data, and a small window shows progress for long steps.

features.title: Lighter launcher
features.text: The launcher uses far less CPU next to a running game, and its first status check is much faster.

features.title: Non-ASCII paths
features.text: Cyrillic, Chinese or accented user names and game folders no longer crash quests or stop SET mods loading.

features.title: Windows server item registration
features.text: New items and recipes register again on native Windows dedicated servers.

features.title: Reinstall keeps your profile
features.text: After uninstalling and reinstalling Kiln, the profile you used is active again.

features.title: SET mods with C# mods
features.text: SET mods load again when C# mods are on.

features.title: shroudlink MODS tab
features.text: shroudlink's client addon is now added as a mod of its own, so its in-game MODS tab can appear.

released.title: Hook registry and faster EML
released.summary: Stops the launcher removing mods while the game runs, makes EML mods start much faster, puts every hook in one registry, and helps closed-source DLL mods work next to Kiln.

features.title: One hook registry
features.text: Every hook Kiln places goes through one registry, with ordered chains of handlers that other loaders' mods share.

features.title: Load DLL mods late
features.text: Closed-source DLL mods such as XHL-Core can load after Kiln and ShroudForge, with a one-click switch for hook overlaps.

features.title: Compatibility rules
features.text: Compatibility rules can warn about, load late, or switch off a DLL or mod known to clash.

features.title: Faster EML starts
features.text: EML mods read far less game data at start: unchanged files are not read again.

features.title: Faster managed hooks
features.text: Hooks from managed mods cost much less per call than in dev.20.

features.title: Smoother play
features.text: Mod status lines never stall the menu, tick or frame, and EMF portraits are drawn off the boot thread.

features.title: Mods safe while playing
features.text: The launcher no longer removes a Library version while Enshrouded runs.

features.title: Chat next to EMF hooks
features.text: Kiln's chat commands no longer hide players' lines when an EMF mod hooks chat in front of Kiln.

features.title: Linked home folders
features.text: Mod installs no longer refuse a folder on systems where the home folder is a link, such as Fedora Atomic and Bazzite.

features.title: Unreadable EML mods
features.text: An EML mod that cannot be read is switched off with a reason, and the other mods still run.

features.title: Unsafe file names refused
features.text: File names that Windows would change are refused in mod zips, runtime bundles and modpacks.

released.title: Windows profiles and EMF 0.6
released.summary: Fixes profile activation on Windows, updates EMF support to 0.6, and adds many building blocks for mod authors.

features.title: EMF 0.6 support
features.text: Kiln supports EMF 0.6 (API 27), including its hidden-chat networking and portrait generation.

features.title: More building blocks
features.text: Mods get new and extended loot, quest and dialogue, furniture, crafting station, menu, screen effect and UI blocks.

features.title: World programs
features.text: Mods can run declarative world programs with checked component access and cleanup when the mod unloads.

features.title: Inventory transfers and loot
features.text: Inventory transfers and saved default loot keep stable identities through saves, renames and restarts.

features.title: Server flame progression
features.text: Mods can work with server flame progression, localisation, resource reflection and SET integration.

features.title: Smoother pacing
features.text: Frame and tick pacing and mod cleanup across unloads and world changes are better.

features.title: Windows profile activation
features.text: Profile activation no longer fails on Windows with an "Incorrect function" error.

features.title: ShroudForge startup on Windows
features.text: ShroudForge's startup no longer fails on Windows over open archives or failed file replacements.

features.title: Portraits on mounted drives
features.text: EMF portrait generation works under Wine and Proton with game libraries on mounted drives.

features.title: Saved mod attachments kept
features.text: Saved mod attachments are kept when their template details are briefly unavailable.

released.title: Frame rate and update fixes
released.summary: A fix release for dev.18: a large frame rate drop with an active profile, and updates that skipped new parts.

features.title: Missing parts on Runtime page
features.text: The Runtime page's Parts card shows parts that are missing and lets you add them.

features.title: Frame rate with profiles
features.text: The game no longer drops to about 10 fps when a profile is active. SET support checked every file each frame.

features.title: Updates install new parts
features.text: Updates now install parts that are new or became default, such as EMF, EML and ShroudForge support. Parts you turned off stay off.

released.title: Other frameworks' mods run
released.summary: Mods made for other Enshrouded frameworks run on Kiln, unchanged, without their own loader installed. Creative mode grows, and dedicated servers get a server pack.

features.title: EML and ShroudForge mods
features.text: EML mods, including ShroudForge mods, run on Kiln. ShroudForge comes with Kiln, or you can use your own.

features.title: EMF mods
features.text: EMF mods made for EMF 0.3.3 up to 0.5.1 run on Kiln, and EMF support is installed by default.

features.title: SET, Enshwick and more
features.text: SET Lua mods, Enshwick mods, Greeneye, Shroudtopia, Creative Mode (Flame) and shroudlink server mods run on Kiln.

features.title: Kiln steps aside
features.text: If another loader is installed too, Kiln steps aside or chains it. Installing Kiln never switches another loader off.

features.title: Manage every framework's mods
features.text: The launcher manages mods of every framework like Kiln mods: profiles, server sync and modpacks.

features.title: Bigger creative mode
features.text: Creative mode adds a creative menu with items, day and night control, free crafting, map reveal, gear upgrades and more.

features.title: Glider pitch control
features.text: The creative glider pitches up with S and dives with W, and the mouse stays free to look around.

features.title: Dedicated server pack
features.text: A server pack unzips into a server folder, also on rented FTP-only hosts, with a new guide and Linux systemd units.

features.title: Faster, shared hooks
features.text: Kiln finds game functions even when another framework hooked them first, and boots about twice as fast.

features.title: Faults switch off a part
features.text: A fault in Kiln's own code is caught and that part is switched off until the next start.

features.title: Safer mod imports
features.text: Mod imports have size limits and refuse links, and a file inside a mod can no longer fake ownership.

released.title: Steam Deck white window fix
released.summary: Fixes the game hanging on a white window on Steam Deck, and makes Kiln's overlay attach to the graphics more carefully everywhere.

features.title: Careful overlay attach
features.text: Kiln's overlay checks each graphics function on its own and never hooks over its own or another program's hooks.

features.title: Steam Deck white window
features.text: The game no longer hangs on a white window when it starts with Kiln on a Steam Deck.

released.title: Nexus in the launcher
released.summary: Brings Nexus Mods browsing into the launcher, Steam Deck fixes, and many new tools for mod authors: drawing, creature AI and particle shaders.

features.title: Nexus Mods catalog
features.text: The launcher could browse, search, install and update mods from Nexus. It is switched off since dev.20, while Nexus approval is pending.

features.title: No Kiln notice
features.text: When Steam starts the game without Kiln, the launcher says so and shows what to do instead of waiting forever.

features.title: Drawing from mods
features.text: Mods get a per-frame event and can draw lines, boxes, text and images on screen and in the world.

features.title: New blocks
features.text: Blocks for status and perk icons, tools, piercing projectiles, props with glTF models and colliders, and cooked sounds.

features.title: Creature AI and behaviour
features.text: Mods can set faction relations, sense filters and behaviour rules that heal, summon, cast and apply effects.

features.title: Animation retargeting
features.text: Mods can retarget animations from one creature's rig to another.

features.title: Safe particle shaders
features.text: Particle shaders from mods work again, as small checked hook functions with loop, memory and time limits.

features.title: Material reskins
features.text: Material reskins are back, and they come off when their mod unloads.

features.title: Safer dropped mods
features.text: Dropped mods and archives are checked more carefully, and every dropped modpack asks before it installs.

features.title: Steam Deck mode fixes
features.text: In Steam Deck mode, focus no longer gets lost after dialogs, B always closes a dialog, and long text scrolls.

features.title: Creative mode fixes
features.text: Edited creative presets are no longer overwritten, and the glider respects its speed cap.

released.title: Nexus build updates
released.summary: The launcher downloaded from Nexus Mods now gets new versions from the Nexus page instead of updating itself.

features.title: Nexus build updates
features.text: The Nexus launcher build points to the Nexus page for new versions. frostdev.io and GitHub builds still update themselves.

released.title: Steam Deck mode and /creative
released.summary: Adds a controller-friendly Steam Deck mode, a simpler first start, admin creative mode, and world progress and player rules for mod authors. Linux builds start again on most systems.

features.title: Steam Deck mode
features.text: A controller-friendly launcher starts by itself on a Steam Deck, with Play, your mods, adding mods and installing Kiln.

features.title: Simpler first start
features.text: The launcher finds the game, puts Install Kiln on Play, makes a My mods profile, and takes dropped mods with Undo.

features.title: Creative mode for admins
features.text: Admins can use /creative to fly, build anywhere, mine instantly and have unlimited vitals, with a plane-like glider.

features.title: World progress for mods
features.text: Mods can read world progress such as flame level, bosses, shrines and each character's quests, with events.

features.title: Per-player rules
features.text: Mods can set per-player rules for flying, building, costs, mining, vitals, water refill and gliding.

features.title: Water container data
features.text: Mods can read, set and fill water containers, and the values are saved.

features.title: Linux builds start again
features.text: The AppImage and .deb start again on Steam Deck and most distributions. Linux builds need glibc 2.35 or newer.

features.title: Camera freeze with creatures
features.text: The game no longer freezes for minutes per frame when its camera breaks with creatures nearby.

features.title: Windows server stop
features.text: On Windows, stopping a dedicated server no longer closes the launcher, and Start finishes when the world is up.

released.title: New server fix
released.summary: A launcher hotfix for creating dedicated servers.

features.title: New server works again
features.text: New server works again in the released launcher, instead of stopping with a path error.

released.title: Water containers
released.summary: Adds water container items for mods and small launcher and server improvements.

features.title: Water containers
features.text: Mods can make watering cans and water pouches with their own capacity, up to 1,023 charges, and fill speed.

features.title: Install Kiln on servers
features.text: The server Overview offers Install Kiln when a server has none, and Update Kiln once it has.

features.title: Player health for admins
features.text: The admin Players page shows players' health.

features.title: Accurate running clock
features.text: The launcher's running clock counts from the game's real start, also when Steam started the game.

features.title: Update leftovers cleaned
features.text: The launcher removes the Windows updater's leftover temp folders and says when an install kept a changed file.

features.title: Versioned SDK packages
features.text: The SDK packages carry their release version, so mod builds use the right one.

released.title: Windows start fix
released.summary: Fixes a Windows crash right after Kiln starts and gets the in-game overlay working on Windows.

features.title: Windows crash at start
features.text: On Windows, the game no longer crashes right after Kiln starts.

features.title: Overlay on Windows
features.text: On Windows, the Kiln overlay works: Insert opens it, and the Mods entries appear on the main and pause menus.

released.title: First public build
released.summary: The first published build, collecting everything since the start of the project: content blocks for mods, a launcher with self-update and a save editor, and many fixes.

features.title: Launcher self-update
features.text: The launcher can update itself.

features.title: Save editor
features.text: The launcher has a save editor, styled in the launcher's own look.

features.title: World and NPC blocks
features.text: Mods get world, NPC, cosmetic, ability and building blocks, plus VFX and player state.

features.title: Terrain and NPCs
features.text: Mods can add terrain materials, NPC reactions, first-start NPCs and furniture texts.

features.title: Runtime version notices
features.text: Kiln names mods that need a newer runtime, and its logs are quieter and more accurate.

features.title: Faster content loading
features.text: Mod content loads faster.

features.title: World-load deadlock
features.text: A deadlock while loading a world is fixed.

features.title: Build menu crash
features.text: A crash in the build menu is fixed, along with a hot-load race and creature rule problems.

features.title: Content fixes
features.text: Stations, on-hit statuses, item texts, VFX colours and client creature loading work correctly.

upcoming.title: Flamebound Ledger without a host setup
upcoming.summary: Flamebound Ledger no longer needs its own Kiln host setup: Kiln now provides the framework for checked item moves, which the Ledger's next version uses.

features.title: Flamebound Ledger runs on Kiln as it is
features.text: Flamebound Ledger's item transfers no longer need the Ledger's own Kiln host setup, which only worked on one Kiln version. From this release the Ledger uses Kiln's checked moves; update the Ledger when its new version is out.

features.title: Checked item moves for mods
features.text: Kiln provides the framework for checked item moves: a mod can move items out of a slot only while the slot still holds what the mod last saw, and only into the exact slot it names, so a drag made on an old view or a request sent twice never moves the wrong items. Experimental in this patch, normal API from 0.2.0-dev.32.

upcoming.title: Settings of removed mods, marked
upcoming.summary: The Configs window marks the settings Kiln keeps for mods you removed as not installed, read-only, and lets you clear them into Kiln's settings backups.

features.title: Removed mods' settings are marked "Not installed"
features.text: Remove keeps a mod's settings, so adding the mod again brings them back. The Configs window now lists those kept settings apart, under "Not installed", read-only, instead of next to your mods with switches that looked live. Clear, or Clear all, moves them into Kiln's settings backups after asking; your installed mods' settings are never touched (thanks HTR).

upcoming.title: Pets, taming and more registries
upcoming.summary: Kiln makes pets and taming possible for mods, and adds registries for creatures, spells, buffs, perks, stations, skills, world rules, limits and loot.

features.title: Pets for mods
features.text: Mods can add pets: Kiln keeps each pet saved with its owner, has it follow and fight, and handles a downed pet and its revive. Each mod decides how its pets behave, such as what they may attack and what reviving costs.

features.title: Taming creatures
features.text: Mods can use the game's own taming of wild animals and add steps of their own, such as feeding, weakening or using a tool, and decide what each step costs and whether a failed step is refunded.

features.title: Creature, perk, spell and buff registries
features.text: Mods and data packs edit creatures, enemy attacks, perks, buff durations and stacking, and spell and ability timing by Kiln's stable names, as they edit items and recipes today, so they keep working after game updates.

features.title: Station, skill, world-rule and limit registries
features.text: Crafting stations, skill costs, no-build zones and play areas, difficulty bounds, and Kiln's limits such as the flame altar cap and the gifting range become registries too.

features.title: Loot registries
features.text: The world-wide loot rarity weights and every random loot table become registries, so loot mods such as Loot Rarity Leveler run on Kiln's stable names.

features.title: NPC dialogue for mods
features.text: Building on NPC speech: a replaced greeting picks a new line each time an NPC greets, mods can set farewells and the talk menu's own line, and villagers without a talk page can get one of the mod's, for survival mods such as Living Larder.

features.title: One view over every registry
features.text: One typed view over every game resource with Kiln's names, Stable, Advanced and Native labels across the modding API, and editor hints that point mods from old paths to registry fields.

features.title: Equipment rules on the registries
features.text: Mods' gear and equipment-rule calls keep working and become registry edits where Kiln has proven they match, so they show in the Conflicts view and carry over game updates.

features.title: ShroudForge mods on the registries
features.text: ShroudForge mods' data edits get named owners in the Conflicts view, and their effects can replay on Kiln's registries (opt-in).

features.title: Cooked terrain tiles
features.text: Tools and tests for cooked terrain tiles; nothing reaches mods yet.

features.title: More registry values
features.text: Storage reach, skill values and requirements, buff strength and tick rate, ability length, and projectile and area values join the registries.

features.title: Faster starts with big registry packs
features.text: Kiln reuses a world's registry plan when nothing it read has changed, and joining checks the new registries too.

features.title: Clicks on the world map
features.text: Mods react to a click or right-click on the world map with the world position and the marker under the cursor, add an entry to the menu there, and read the map's centre and zoom.

features.title: Wildlife and farm pets
features.text: Wildlife and farm animals can be pets, pets can have brains of their own, and a mod can choose a downed body for its pets.

upcoming.title: Attach, drive and move anything
upcoming.summary: The engine pieces that make mounts and vehicles possible: attachments, player-driven creatures, movement modes with flight, animations from code, bodies of any shape and cameras per entity. Mods decide how their mounts behave.

features.title: Attachments
features.text: Mods put a player, creature or prop on a joint of another entity, with an offset they can change every step; every player sees it, and attaching and detaching are events a mod can refuse.

features.title: Player-driven creatures
features.text: A player's movement keys (move, look, jump, sprint) steer a creature or entity a mod controls.

features.title: Player input as data
features.text: Mods read a player's movement and held keys on the server, typed.

features.title: Player actions on hold
features.text: While a mod's state lasts, mods switch off the game's own actions such as the glider, dodging and building, and the fall state and fall damage.

features.title: Movement modes
features.text: Mods set an entity's movement: ground, jump and flight (hover or momentum), with take-off and a controlled landing; the values are a registry data packs can tune.

features.title: Animations from code
features.text: Mods play, blend and cancel animation states on creatures and players from code, drive a movement graph by speed, and give players full-body poses of their own.

features.title: Bodies of any shape
features.text: Creature bodies from a mod's own skeleton, flying ones too, with bounds and named attach points, not only copies of the game's bases.

features.title: Cameras per entity
features.text: A camera profile that follows an entity, with its own distance, height and bounds, while the mouse still turns it.

features.title: E prompts in a mod's own words
features.text: The server sends an interaction prompt's text, so players need nothing extra installed to read it, and prompts work on things that move.

features.title: Owned things saved with the character
features.text: Anything a player owns, not only pets, is saved with their character and comes back.

later.title: Nexus catalog back
later.text: The launcher's Nexus catalog, sign-in and Mod Manager Download links come back once Nexus Mods approves Kiln's sign-in.

later.title: More room for VFX
later.text: Kiln could make room for more VFX in a game, so mods' effects stop running out of space.

later.title: Fog and light
later.text: Mods could set fog and light; today only the weather can be chosen.

later.title: Weather in one place
later.text: Mods could place a weather phenomenon where they want it, not only start it in its region.

later.title: Writes in the client world
later.text: Mods could make tracked writes in the player's own game world, as they already can on the server.

later.title: More event filters
later.text: Mods could filter events by template or component, not only by entity.

later.title: Loot and icons sent to players
later.text: Servers could send loot tables and mods' PNG icons to joined players, so fewer mods need to be installed on both sides.

later.title: Item data between worlds
later.text: Data a mod keeps on one item could travel with the character to another world.

later.title: More affix kinds
later.text: Rolled item modifiers could get the kinds they do not have yet.

later.title: Custom surface shaders
later.text: Mods could draw models with shaders of their own: transparent shaders first, opaque ones after.

later.title: Screen effects under the UI
later.text: Screen effects could draw under the game's UI, or as a pass with depth, several mods in a chain.

later.title: Particles that draw models
later.text: A mod's particles could draw a model, not only a sprite.

later.title: Chests and doors of your own
later.text: Mods' chests could come with contents and lids, and doors on a mod's own model could open.

later.title: New regions in world generation
later.text: Mods could add whole generated regions; terrain overlays placed over the world come first.

later.title: Ragdoll deaths
later.text: Creatures could fall as ragdolls; today a creature has a death state only.
later.note: Needs physics in the game client

milestones.title: Kiln 1.0
milestones.text: The planned releases lead to Kiln 1.0. At 1.0 the C# modding API is frozen as API 1.0.0.
